    #!/bin/sh
    exec 2>&1
    set -eu
    
    # Out-of-band chat responder: subscribes to responder wake topic and
    # answers pending chat turns via the 3tchedFS lungs mount.
    
    wait_dep() {
        sv start "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        i=0
        until sv check "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
            i=$((i+1))
            [ "$i" -ge 90 ] && { echo "dependency $1 not ready after 90s" >&2; exit 1; }
            sleep 1
        done
    }
    
    # Dependencies: the gRPC bridge must be running (owns the turn registry),
    # EMQX must be running (for MQTT wake subscription), and the chatbot's
    # identity roots must be mounted (for 3tchedFS access).
    wait_dep op-grpc-bridge
    wait_dep emqx
    wait_dep identity-roots
    
    set -a
    [ -r /etc/op-dbus/environment ] && . /etc/op-dbus/environment
    set +a
    
    # The control-plane chatbot's service identity. This responder answers
    # turns designated to this principal.
    RESPONDER_PRINCIPAL_ID="${OP_CONTROL_PLANE_CHATBOT_PRINCIPAL_ID:-1262e982-14c1-44d4-0771-7ce74213211b}"
    
    # The 3tchedFS lungs mount for this chatbot identity.
    LUNGS_MOUNT="${OP_CHAT_RESPONDER_LUNGS_MOUNT:-/opt/run-mounts/3tched}"
    
    # MQTT broker (private loopback backend).
    MQTT_HOST="${OP_CHAT_RESPONDER_MQTT_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"
    MQTT_PORT="${OP_CHAT_RESPONDER_MQTT_PORT:-1883}"
    
    export RUST_LOG="${OP_CHAT_RESPONDER_LOG:-info,rumqttc=warn}"
    
    # Wait for the lungs mount to be available.
    i=0
    while [ ! -d "$LUNGS_MOUNT/chat_response" ]; do
        i=$((i+1))
        if [ "$i" -ge 60 ]; then
            echo "3tchedFS lungs mount not available at $LUNGS_MOUNT after 60s" >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        sleep 1
    done
    
    args="--principal-id $RESPONDER_PRINCIPAL_ID"
    args="$args --lungs-mount $LUNGS_MOUNT"
    args="$args --mqtt-host $MQTT_HOST"
    args="$args --mqtt-port $MQTT_PORT"
    
    exec /usr/local/bin/op-chat-responder $args

        while :; do
            [ ! -L "$path" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u -- "$path")" = 0 ] &&
                [ $((0$(stat -c %a -- "$path") & 022)) -eq 0 ] || fail "unsafe owner/mode: $path"

    /// Write exactly one identity credential (SID1 or OIA1) into gRPC metadata.
    /// Ported from the legacy interceptor helper; the client keeps no second copy
    /// of the wire bytes beyond the authored credential it was given.
    fn insert_identity_metadata<T>(
        request: &mut Request<T>,
        sealed_id: Option<&[u8]>,
        oracle_assertion: Option<&[u8]>,
        capability_id: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<(), GrpcClientError> {
        let valid_wire =
            |wire: &[u8], magic: &[u8; 4]| wire.len() <= 16 * 1024 && wire.starts_with(magic);
        match (sealed_id, oracle_assertion) {
            (Some(_), Some(_)) => {
                return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                    "multiple identity credentials".into(),
                ));
            }
            (None, None) => {
                return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                    "missing identity credential".into(),
                ));
            }
            (Some(wire), None) => {
                if !valid_wire(wire, b"SID1") {
                    return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                        "invalid SID1 credential".into(),
                    ));
                }
                request.metadata_mut().insert_bin(
                    op_identity::sealed_id::HTTP_HEADER_NAME,
                    MetadataValue::from_bytes(wire),
                );
            }
            (None, Some(wire)) => {
                if !valid_wire(wire, b"OIA1") {
                    return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                        "invalid OIA1 credential".into(),
                    ));
                }
                request.metadata_mut().insert_bin(
                    "x-oracle-identity-assertion-bin",
                    MetadataValue::from_bytes(wire),
                );
            }
        }
        if let Some(capability_id) = capability_id {
            if capability_id.is_empty() {
                return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                    "capability metadata cannot be empty".into(),
                ));

    /// The three core services, backed by one [`BridgeCore`].
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct BridgeService {
        core: BridgeCore,
    }
    
    impl BridgeService {
        /// Serve `core` over tonic.
        pub fn new(core: BridgeCore) -> Self {
            Self { core }
        }
    }
    
    fn mutation_error(code: ErrorCode, message: String) -> MutationError {
        MutationError {
            code: code as i32,
            message,
            deny_reason: None,
        }
    }
    
    /// Translate one wire mutation. Infallible: anything malformed becomes a
    /// [`CoreOperation`] the core rejects at admission, so batch alignment
    /// never depends on translation order.
    fn core_mutation(req: &MutateRequest, actor_default: &str) -> CoreMutation {
        let operation = if req.operation == OperationType::SetProperty as i32 {
            CoreOperation::SetProperty
        } else if req.operation == OperationType::CallMethod as i32 {
            CoreOperation::CallMethod
        } else if req.operation == OperationType::ApplyPatch as i32 {
            CoreOperation::ApplyPatch
        } else {
            CoreOperation::Unknown
        };
        CoreMutation {
            plugin_id: req.plugin_id.clone(),
            object_path: req.object_path.clone(),
            operation,
            member_name: req.member_name.clone(),
            value: req
                .value
                .as_ref()
                .map(proto_value_to_json)
                .unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null),
            actor_id: if req.actor_id.is_empty() {
                actor_default.to_string()
            } else {
                req.actor_id.clone()
            },
            capability_id: req.capability_id.clone(),
            idempotency_key: req.idempotency_key.clone(),
        }
    }
    
    fn mutate_response(result: Result<MutationOutcome, CoreRejection>) -> MutateResponse {
        match result {
            Ok(outcome) => MutateResponse {
                success: true,
                event_id: outcome.event.event_id,
                event_hash: outcome.event.event_hash,
                result: outcome.result.as_ref().map(json_to_proto_value),
                error: None,
                effective_hash: outcome.event.result_effective_hash,
            },
            Err(rejection) => MutateResponse {
                success: false,
                event_id: 0,
                event_hash: String::new(),
                result: None,
                error: Some(mutation_error(rejection.code, rejection.message)),
                effective_hash: String::new(),
            },
        }
    }

    //!
    //! The binary supplies command words, flags and token schemas. This plugin owns
    //! admission policy; help text cannot establish that a command is read-only.

    fn path_text(path: &Path) -> Result<String> {

    }
    
    fn sha256_file(path: &Path) -> Result<String> {
        let mut file = File::open(path).with_context(|| format!("open {}", path.display()))?;
        let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
        let mut buffer = [0u8; 64 * 1024];
        loop {
            let count = file.read(&mut buffer)?;
            if count == 0 {
                break;
            }
            hasher.update(&buffer[..count]);
        }
        Ok(format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize()))
    }
    
    fn manifest_version(manifest: &Value, binary_hash: &str) -> Result<String> {
        ensure!(manifest["format"] == MANIFEST_FORMAT, "unsupported threetched manifest format");
        ensure!(manifest.pointer("/source/mode").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("unmodified-upstream"),
            "threetched manifest is not unmodified upstream");
        ensure!(manifest.get("patches").is_none(), "threetched manifest still carries the retired patch contract");
        ensure!(manifest.pointer("/artifact/name").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("threetched"), "manifest is not for the threetched executable");
        ensure!(manifest.pointer("/artifact/sha256").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some(binary_hash), "threetched executable differs from its manifest");
        let upstream_binary = manifest.pointer("/artifact/upstream_binary").and_then(Value::as_str)
            .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
            .context("threetched manifest has no upstream binary")?;
        let tag = manifest.pointer("/upstream/tag").and_then(Value::as_str)
            .context("threetched manifest has no upstream version")?;
        let version = tag.strip_prefix('v').filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
            .context("threetched manifest version must start with v")?;
        Ok(format!("{upstream_binary} {version}"))
    }
    
    fn capture() -> Result<Captured> {
        let binary = super::chat_router_paths::binary()?;
        let manifest = super::chat_router_paths::manifest()?;
        let config_dir = super::chat_router_paths::config_dir()?;
        let (capture_binary, capture_manifest) = super::chat_router_paths::capture_paths()?;
        let manifest_sha256 = sha256_file(&capture_manifest)?;
        let descriptor: Value = serde_json::from_reader(File::open(&capture_manifest)?)?;
        let binary_sha256 = sha256_file(&capture_binary)?;
        let version = manifest_version(&descriptor, &binary_sha256)?;
        let bare_version = version.rsplit_once(' ').map(|(_, bare)| bare.to_owned())
            .filter(|bare| !bare.is_empty())
            .expect("manifest_version ends with the bare version");
        let surface = ThreetchedSurface::capture_with_config(&capture_binary, &config_dir)?;
        ensure!(surface.binary_sha256() == binary_sha256, "threetched executable changed during capture");
        ensure!(surface.version() == Some(version.as_str()), "threetched version differs from its manifest");
        ensure!(sha256_file(&capture_manifest)? == manifest_sha256, "threetched manifest changed during capture");
        let state = ThreetchedState {
            binary: path_text(&binary)?,
            manifest: path_text(&manifest)?,
            config_dir: path_text(&config_dir)?,
            binary_sha256: surface.binary_sha256().to_owned(),
            manifest_sha256,
            surface: serde_json::to_value(surface.snapshot())?,
        };
        Ok(Captured { state, surface, version: bare_version })
    }

        /// Enforce the complete serialized seal-input bound, including JSON escaping

        pub fn validate_size(&self) -> Result<()> {
            struct Ceiling(usize);
            impl std::io::Write for Ceiling {
                fn write(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<usize> {
                    self.0 = self.0.checked_add(bytes.len())
                        .filter(|size| *size <= CAPTURE_BYTES)
                        .ok_or_else(|| std::io::Error::other("threetched snapshot exceeds byte ceiling"))?;
                    Ok(bytes.len())
                }
                fn flush(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<()> { Ok(()) }
            }
            serde_json::to_writer(Ceiling(0), self)?;
            Ok(())
        }

    /// discoverable, but it cannot redirect an admitted operation to another root.
    fn validate_config_selector(value: &Value, config_dir: &Path, spellings: &[&str]) -> Result<()> {
        let expected = path_text(config_dir)?;

## Assistant

The running ZeroClaw daemon selects `/var/lib/tched-router` **explicitly on its command line**:

```text
--config-dir /var/lib/tched-router
```

Its environment also contains both `THREETCHED_CONFIG_DIR` and `TCHED_ROUTER_CONFIG_DIR` with that same value. So removing either environment variable alone would **not** change the running daemon’s config directory.

The service script also uses `TCHED_ROUTER_CONFIG_DIR` to choose the directory for its setup commands, and the plugin’s schema-capture code uses it too. I haven’t established that those uses are redundant. I made no changes or restart.

    //! The threetched service paths shared by chat-router plugin surfaces.
    //! Defaults mirror deploy/runit/tched-router/run; service overrides use its
    //! THREETCHED_BIN, THREETCHED_MANIFEST and TCHED_ROUTER_CONFIG_DIR variables.
    
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    
    use anyhow::{Result, ensure};
    
    pub const DEFAULT_BINARY: &str = "/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/threetched/threetched";
    pub const DEFAULT_CONFIG_DIR: &str = "/var/lib/tched-router";
    pub const DEFAULT_MANIFEST: &str = "/usr/share/op-dbus/threetched-manifests/tched-router.json";
    
    fn absolute_env_path(name: &str, default: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
        let path = std::env::var_os(name)
            .map(PathBuf::from)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(default));
        ensure!(path.is_absolute(), "{name} must be an absolute path");
        Ok(path)
    }
    
    pub fn binary() -> Result<PathBuf> {
        absolute_env_path("THREETCHED_BIN", DEFAULT_BINARY)
    }
    
    pub fn config_dir() -> Result<PathBuf> {
        absolute_env_path("TCHED_ROUTER_CONFIG_DIR", DEFAULT_CONFIG_DIR)
    }
    
    pub fn manifest() -> Result<PathBuf> {
        absolute_env_path("THREETCHED_MANIFEST", DEFAULT_MANIFEST)
    }
    
    /// Select the binary and provenance manifest used only to capture the sealed
    /// CLI contract. Runtime dispatch continues to use [`binary`] and [`manifest`].
    /// Build/seal invocations may point these selectors at a not-yet-installed
    /// candidate, but must supply the pair together so provenance cannot drift.
    pub(crate) fn capture_paths() -> Result<(PathBuf, PathBuf)> {
        match (
            std::env::var_os("THREETCHED_CAPTURE_BIN"),
            std::env::var_os("THREETCHED_CAPTURE_MANIFEST"),
        ) {
            (None, None) => Ok((binary()?, manifest()?)),
            (Some(binary), Some(manifest)) => {
                let binary = PathBuf::from(binary);
                let manifest = PathBuf::from(manifest);
                ensure!(binary.is_absolute(), "THREETCHED_CAPTURE_BIN must be an absolute path");
                ensure!(manifest.is_absolute(), "THREETCHED_CAPTURE_MANIFEST must be an absolute path");
                Ok((binary, manifest))
            }
            _ => anyhow::bail!("THREETCHED_CAPTURE_BIN and THREETCHED_CAPTURE_MANIFEST must be supplied together"),
        }
    }
    //! Bounded execution of the binary-backed filesystem surface.
    //!
    //! The child owns a new process group. Its leader remains unreaped until group
    //! cleanup is complete, so a group signal cannot race reuse of the leader PID.
    //! Both pipes are drained on this thread; no reader can outlive the mount job.
    
    use crate::fuse_buffers::{Budget, Buffer, DOCUMENT_LIMIT};
    use std::io::{self, Read};
    use std::os::fd::{AsRawFd, RawFd};
    use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;
    use std::path::Path;
    use std::process::{Child, Command, ExitStatus, Stdio};
    use std::sync::{
        Arc,
        atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
    };
    use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
    
    const POLL_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(50);
    const READ_CHUNK: usize = 8192;
    
    /// Discovery uses the same bounded child lifetime as mounted execution,
    /// without depending on the FUSE engine or importing it into read examples.
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn capture_surface(binary: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
        capture_surface_with_config(binary, args, None)
    }
    
    pub(crate) fn capture_surface_with_config(
        binary: &Path,
        args: &[&str],
        config_dir: Option<&Path>,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
        let budget = Arc::new(Budget::default());
        let cancelled = AtomicBool::new(false);
        let mut command = Command::new(binary);
        if let Some(config_dir) = config_dir {
            anyhow::ensure!(config_dir.is_absolute(), "capture config directory must be absolute");
            command.env_clear()
                .env("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin")
                .env("HOME", config_dir.join("home"))
                .env("THREETCHED_CONFIG_DIR", config_dir)
                .env("ZEROCLAW_CONFIG_DIR", config_dir);
        }
        command
            .args(args)
            .env("NO_COLOR", "1")
            .env("CLICOLOR", "0")
            .env("TERM", "dumb")
            .env("LANGUAGE", "en")
            .env("LC_ALL", "C")
            .env("LANG", "C");
        let output = run(
            &mut command,
            &budget,
            &cancelled,
            Limits {
                timeout: Duration::from_secs(10),
                output: 4 * 1024 * 1024,
            },
        )?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            output.status.success(),
            "{} {:?} exited with {}: {}",
            binary.display(),
            args,
            output.status,
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr.bytes)
        );
        Ok(std::str::from_utf8(&output.stdout.bytes)?.to_owned())
    }
    
    #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
    pub(super) struct Limits {
        pub(super) timeout: Duration,
        /// Combined stdout and stderr length, additionally capped by DOCUMENT_LIMIT.
        pub(super) output: usize,
    }
    
    impl Default for Limits {
        fn default() -> Self {
            Self {
                timeout: Duration::from_secs(600),
                output: DOCUMENT_LIMIT,
            }
        }
    }

    fn capture() -> Result<Captured> {
        let binary = super::chat_router_paths::binary()?;
        let manifest = super::chat_router_paths::manifest()?;
        let config_dir = super::chat_router_paths::config_dir()?;
        let (capture_binary, capture_manifest) = super::chat_router_paths::capture_paths()?;
        let manifest_sha256 = sha256_file(&capture_manifest)?;
        let descriptor: Value = serde_json::from_reader(File::open(&capture_manifest)?)?;
        let binary_sha256 = sha256_file(&capture_binary)?;
        let version = manifest_version(&descriptor, &binary_sha256)?;
        let bare_version = version.rsplit_once(' ').map(|(_, bare)| bare.to_owned())
            .filter(|bare| !bare.is_empty())
            .expect("manifest_version ends with the bare version");
        let surface = ThreetchedSurface::capture_with_config(&capture_binary, &config_dir)?;
        ensure!(surface.binary_sha256() == binary_sha256, "threetched executable changed during capture");
        ensure!(surface.version() == Some(version.as_str()), "threetched version differs from its manifest");
        ensure!(sha256_file(&capture_manifest)? == manifest_sha256, "threetched manifest changed during capture");
        let state = ThreetchedState {
            binary: path_text(&binary)?,
            manifest: path_text(&manifest)?,
            config_dir: path_text(&config_dir)?,
            binary_sha256: surface.binary_sha256().to_owned(),
            manifest_sha256,
            surface: serde_json::to_value(surface.snapshot())?,
        };
        Ok(Captured { state, surface, version: bare_version })
    }
    
    /// The pinned binary surface captured once at seal.
    pub(crate) fn surface() -> Result<&'static ThreetchedSurface> {
        Ok(&captured()?.surface)
    }
    
    /// The threetched `config schema` document from the same pinned capture.
    pub(crate) fn config_schema() -> Result<&'static Value> {
        Ok(captured()?.surface.schema_json())
    }
    
    /// The bare upstream version (e.g. "0.8.4") verified against the manifest.
    pub(crate) fn binary_version() -> Result<&'static str> {
        Ok(captured()?.version.as_str())
    }

    impl StatePlugin for ThreetchedPlugin {
        fn name(&self) -> &str { PLUGIN_NAME }

        fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> { Some(threetched_schema()) }
        async fn calculate_diff(&self, current: &OwnedValue, desired: &OwnedValue) -> Result<StateDiff> {
            ensure!(current == desired && *desired == state_value()?, "threetched discovery descriptor is immutable");
            Ok(StateDiff {
                plugin: PLUGIN_NAME.into(), actions: vec![],
                metadata: DiffMetadata { timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(), current_hash: String::new(), desired_hash: String::new() },
            })
        }
        async fn apply_state(&self, diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
            ensure!(diff.plugin == PLUGIN_NAME && diff.actions.is_empty(), "threetched discovery descriptor is immutable");
            Ok(ApplyResult { success: true, changes_applied: vec![], errors: vec![], checkpoint: None })
        }
        async fn verify_state(&self, desired: &OwnedValue) -> Result<bool> { Ok(*desired == state_value()?) }
        async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> { bail!("threetched discovery descriptor has no checkpoints") }
        async fn rollback(&self, _: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> { bail!("threetched discovery descriptor has no rollback") }
        fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
            PluginCapabilities { supports_rollback: false, supports_checkpoints: false, supports_verification: true, atomic_operations: false }

    /// Preserve the sealed service context. The CLI's own config selector remains
    /// discoverable, but it cannot redirect an admitted operation to another root.
    fn validate_config_selector(value: &Value, config_dir: &Path, spellings: &[&str]) -> Result<()> {
        let expected = path_text(config_dir)?;
        let one = serde_json::json!([expected]);
        let mut selected = false;
        for spelling in spellings {
            if let Some(selector) = value.get(*spelling) {
                ensure!(!selected, "threetched config selector was supplied through multiple aliases");
                ensure!(selector == &one || selector == &serde_json::json!([one.clone()]), "threetched config selector must select the sealed runtime context");
                selected = true;
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn absolute_env_path(name: &str, default: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {

    fn prepare_command(method: &str, value: &Value, source: &ThreetchedState) -> Result<Command> {
        let binary = super::chat_router_paths::binary()?;
        let manifest = super::chat_router_paths::manifest()?;
        let config_dir = super::chat_router_paths::config_dir()?;
        ensure!(binary == Path::new(&source.binary) && manifest == Path::new(&source.manifest)
            && config_dir == Path::new(&source.config_dir), "threetched runtime paths changed since seal");
        ensure!(sha256_file(&manifest)? == source.manifest_sha256,
            "threetched manifest changed since seal");
        let snapshot: SurfaceSnapshot = serde_json::from_value(source.surface.clone())?;
        let surface = ThreetchedSurface::from_snapshot(&binary, &snapshot)?;
        ensure!(surface.binary_sha256() == source.binary_sha256, "threetched sealed source digests disagree");
        let descriptor: Value = serde_json::from_reader(File::open(&manifest)?)?;
        manifest_version(&descriptor, surface.binary_sha256())?;
        let config_spellings = surface.option_spellings(method, "--config-dir")?;
        validate_config_selector(value, &config_dir, &config_spellings)?;
        let argv = surface.arguments(method, value).context("invalid threetched CLI arguments")?;
        // No interactive terminal/content-input contract exists. Refuse before
        // constructing or spawning a command; never translate runner failures.
        validate_noninteractive_command(method, value, &surface)?;
        // Match the existing chat-router service owner. This backend is a shared
        // service selected by exact capabilities, never a caller-supplied identity
        // or a guessed mapping from SID1 to an operating-system account.
        let mut command = if nix::unistd::geteuid().is_root() {
            let mut command = Command::new("/usr/bin/chpst");
            command.args(["-u", "jeremy:jeremy"]).arg(surface.binary_path());
            command
        } else {
            let owner = nix::unistd::User::from_name("jeremy")?
                .context("threetched service owner is absent")?;
            ensure!(nix::unistd::geteuid() == owner.uid && nix::unistd::getegid() == owner.gid,
                "threetched dispatch must run as its configured service owner");
            Command::new(surface.binary_path())
        };
        command.args(argv)
            .env_clear()
            .env("PATH", "/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin")
            .env("HOME", config_dir.join("home"))
            .env("USER", "jeremy")
            .env("THREETCHED_CONFIG_DIR", config_dir)
            .env("LANGUAGE", "en")
            .env("LC_ALL", "C")
            .env("LANG", "C")
            .env("NO_COLOR", "1");
        Ok(command)
    }

    //! Control-plane chat follows the dedicated native agent's configured model.
    //!
    //! This module observes the `control_plane` agent. It never changes the
    //! dashboard selection or accepts a request-level provider/model override.
    
    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    use anyhow::{Context, ensure};
    use op_plugins::state_plugins::chat_router::{ChatInput, ChatOutput};
    use serde::Serialize;
    
    use crate::chat_mode_routing::CONTROL_PLANE_AGENT;
    use crate::chat_router_generation::NativeGenerationAdmission;
    use crate::chat_router_runtime::{RuntimeSelection, ChatRouterRuntimeClient};
    
    #[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
    struct RouteDecision<'a> {
        native_alias: &'a str,
        provider: &'a str,
        model: &'a str,
        source: &'a str,
    }
    
    /// Pin the observed native selection into the request. Caller-supplied
    /// provider/model fields are not control-plane configuration authority.
    fn apply_native_selection(
        input: &mut ChatInput,
        selection: &RuntimeSelection,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        ensure!(
            !selection.provider.trim().is_empty() && !selection.model.trim().is_empty(),
            "control-plane native agent has no configured provider/model"
        );
        input.provider.clone_from(&selection.provider);
        input.model.clone_from(&selection.model);
        Ok(())
    }
    
    /// Execute under the caller's existing native admission guard. Provider-only
    /// callers use stateless generation; chat callers use the native A2A agent.
    pub(crate) async fn complete(
        input: ChatInput,
        before_prompt: Arc<dyn NativeGenerationAdmission>,
        provider_only: bool,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<ChatOutput> {
        let client = ChatRouterRuntimeClient::for_agent_alias(CONTROL_PLANE_AGENT)
            .with_sealed_identity(before_prompt.sealed_identity());
        complete_with_client(input, before_prompt, provider_only, client).await
    }
    
    async fn complete_with_client(
        mut input: ChatInput,
        before_prompt: Arc<dyn NativeGenerationAdmission>,
        provider_only: bool,
        client: ChatRouterRuntimeClient,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<ChatOutput> {
        before_prompt
            .check()
            .await
            .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("control-plane routing admission failed: {error}"))?;
        let selection = client
            .current_selection()
            .await
            .context("control-plane native agent selection is unavailable")?;
        apply_native_selection(&mut input, &selection)?;
        before_prompt
            .check()
            .await
            .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("control-plane execution admission failed: {error}"))?;
        let mut output = if provider_only {
            client.complete_under_guard(input, before_prompt).await?
        } else {
            client.chat_under_guard(input).await?
        };
        ensure!(
            output.provider == selection.provider && output.model == selection.model,
            "control-plane native execution did not retain its observed provider/model"
        );
        if !output.usage.is_object() {
            output.usage = serde_json::json!({});
        }
        output.usage["routing"] = serde_json::to_value(RouteDecision {
            native_alias: CONTROL_PLANE_AGENT,
            provider: &output.provider,
            model: &output.model,
            source: "native_agent",
        })?;
        Ok(output)
    }

    export const CONTROL_PLANE_PROVIDER_PATH = "agents.control_plane.model_provider";
    
    export type ControlPlaneModelAccess = "self" | "admin";
    
    /** chat_router no longer seals the own-route operations
     * (`get_own_agent_route_access`/`apply_own_agent_route`), so every identity

    export async function controlPlaneModelAccess(_client: DoorClient): Promise<ControlPlaneModelAccess> {
      return "admin";
    }
    
    export class ControlPlaneMutationUnconfirmedError extends Error {
      constructor(cause: unknown) {
        super(`The model change could not be confirmed: ${cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "door response unavailable"}. Refresh before retrying.`);
        this.name = "ControlPlaneMutationUnconfirmedError";
      }
    }
    
    /** Read the actual dedicated agent route, then resolve it to a provider key. */
    export async function currentControlPlaneModel(client: DoorClient, models: CatalogModel[], own?: boolean): Promise<RouteSelection> {
      const { reference, modelId, uri } = await readDedicatedRoute(client, "control_plane", own);
      const matches = models.filter((model) => model.available && model.model_id === modelId && model.control_plane_profile === reference && inferenceEndpointMatches(uri, model.inference_url_prefix));

      client: DoorClient,

      if (!model) throw new Error("That provider/model is no longer in the catalog. Refresh models.");
      if (!model.available) throw new Error("That catalog model is unavailable. Refresh models and choose an available model.");
      const reference = model.control_plane_profile;
      if (!reference) {
        throw new Error(`The catalog has no native routing binding for ${selection.providerId} / ${selection.modelId}.`);
      }
      const path = nativeProfilePath(reference, "model");
      const access = await controlPlaneModelAccess(client);
      if (access === "self") {
        try {
          const { result } = await client.call<{
            mode?: unknown; reference?: unknown; model?: unknown; uri?: unknown;
          }>(
            TCHED_ROUTER, "apply_own_agent_route",
            { provider_id: selection.providerId, model_id: selection.modelId },
            "cap.software.tched-router.agent.route.self.write@v1",
          );
          const applied = validateDedicatedRoute(result, "control_plane");
          if (applied.reference !== reference || applied.modelId !== selection.modelId) {
            throw new Error("The applied Control Plane route differs from the selected catalog model.");
          }
          assertInferenceEndpoint(applied.uri, model.inference_url_prefix);
          return;
        } catch (cause) {
          // No administrative fallback: a denial or lost response cannot turn the
          // scoped request into an unrelated broad configuration mutation.
          throw new ControlPlaneMutationUnconfirmedError(cause);
        }
      }
      const [currentReference, currentModel, uri] = await Promise.all([
        readRouterValue(client, CONTROL_PLANE_PROVIDER_PATH),
        readRouterValue(client, path),
        verifiedNativeUri(client, reference, model.inference_url_prefix),
      ]);
      if (currentReference === reference && currentModel === selection.modelId) return;
      const providerPointer = "/agents/control_plane/model_provider";
      const modelPointer = `/${path.replaceAll(".", "/")}`;
      const args = { operations: [
        { op: "test", path: providerPointer, value: currentReference },
        { op: "test", path: modelPointer, value: currentModel },
        { op: "test", path: `/${nativeProfilePath(reference, "uri").replaceAll(".", "/")}`, value: uri },
        { op: "replace", path: modelPointer, value: selection.modelId },
        { op: "replace", path: providerPointer, value: reference },
      ] };
      await elevate(TCHED_ROUTER, "config_patch", args);
      try {
        await client.call(TCHED_ROUTER, "config_patch", args, WRITE);
      } catch (cause) {
        // A lost response may follow an accepted write. Reconcile before retry;
        // preflight and elevation failures never reach this branch.
        throw new ControlPlaneMutationUnconfirmedError(cause);
      }
    }
    
    /** One-time sudo ticket for an exact protected call (elevation plugin). */
    export async function authorizeTask(
      client: DoorClient,
      plugin: string,
      method: string,
      args: Record<string, unknown>,
      password: string,
    ): Promise<void> {
      await client.call("elevation", "authorize_task", { plugin, method, args, password }, "elevation.authorize");
    }

    # Repository guidance
    
    This is the 3tched chat interface: a SvelteKit + Vite + TypeScript Json Render app
    wired to the OP-DBUS :8090 door. Backend work belongs in
    repr0bated/operation-dbus-proto, not here.
    
    - Use only Svelte/SvelteKit, Vite and json-render's Svelte renderer for this
      application's UI, for every user and chat mode. Every visible element must
      be declared in the active catalog and implemented in its registry. Installed
      skills for other frameworks are reference material only: do not add
      React/JSX/Next.js components, another
      renderer, or framework dependencies. Use compatible framework-independent
      guidance only. Apply the UI-authoring preflight in all modes while preserving
      each caller's existing grants; skills never grant file or operation access.
      Exception: Remotion, AI Elements (vercel/ai-elements), and Streamdown
      (vercel/streamdown) code and patterns may be used as-is, including their
      native React runtime, scoped strictly to the surfaces that need them
      (e.g. a Remotion video player, an AI Elements chat transcript, or
      Streamdown markdown rendering). Mount each such surface behind its own
      explicit boundary (e.g. a dedicated custom element/iframe host component)
      rather than letting React leak into the rest of the tree; the json-render
      Svelte renderer remains the only renderer for everything outside that
      boundary, and the one-door/one-credential rules below still apply to any
      network calls those surfaces make. The active catalog itself stays
      Svelte/Vite/json-render only: when adding anything to the active catalog
      (src/json-render/catalog/chat-catalog.ts) and its registry
      (src/json-render/catalog/chat-registry.ts), the entry's schema and its
      registered component must be a native Svelte component implemented with
      only Svelte/SvelteKit, Vite, and json-render's Svelte renderer. A React
      boundary host (Remotion/AI Elements/Streamdown) is never registered in the
      active catalog directly — wrap it in a plain Svelte component that owns
      mounting/unmounting the React tree internally, and register only that
      Svelte wrapper. No raw React/JSX ever appears in chat-catalog.ts,
      chat-registry.ts, or the schemas they expose.
    - One door. All network code lives in src/grpc/door.ts and goes through
      operation.v1.PluginService/CallMethod with a declared capability. Do not add
      a second transport, a parallel frontend backend, per-plugin generated stubs,
      or any direct HTTP to op-web for chat.
    - One credential. A request carries exactly one of OIA1 or SID1 as binary
      metadata. The UI never mints, derives, or persists a credential; the retired
      pairing flow (/pair, paircode) must not come back.
    - Errors come from the status channel. Read gRPC status and the envelope's
      MutationError; never branch on a success boolean in a payload.
    - Method names, argument shapes, and capability ids come from the live sealed
      schema (zcall help chat_response <Method> / model_registry / catalog binding
      on the host). Do not reconstruct them from Rust source. If a reseal changes
      them, update src/chat/door-chat-adapter.ts, chat-response-client.ts, and
      their tests together. Chat replies are committed `chat_response` turns only —
      never retired `tched_router.Chat` or `json_render.generate_spec`.
    - Keep backend work behind ChatAdapter. The local adapter must stay usable with
      no credentials, service, or network so UI work can proceed offline.
    - Keep src/json-render/catalog/catalog.ts as the complete reference contract.
      Runtime components live in the smaller chatCatalog and typed chatRegistry;
      adding a schema to the reference catalog does not make it safe to render.
    - Preserve accessible labels, keyboard behavior, visible focus states, and
      aria-live status messaging.
    - proto/operation.proto is a verbatim copy; refresh it from the bridge and
      record the commit in proto/PROVENANCE, then run npm run proto:gen. Never
      hand-edit proto/ or src/grpc/gen/.
    - Run npm run type-check, npm run lint, npm test, and npm run build before
      committing.
    - SvelteKit 3 does not use `svelte.config.js`. vite-plugin-svelte options and
      kit settings live in `svelte-vite-options.ts` and are passed to `sveltekit()`
      from `vite.config.ts` (Vitest uses `svelte({ configFile: false, ... })`).

    # OpenCode Go, an upstream provider like OpenRouter. Chat-completions and
    # Responses models use the threetched `opencode` provider at /zen/go/v1;
    # Messages-API models use the threetched `anthropic` provider, which posts to
    # {uri}/v1/messages. A profile's model is set when the profile is created, so
    # an operator's later model choice survives restarts.
    while IFS='|' read -r agent kind model wire risk; do
        profile="go_$agent"
        provider="$kind.$profile"
        agent_provider=$provider
        if [ "$agent" = control_plane ]; then
            agent_provider=$CONTROL_PLANE_MODEL_PROVIDER
        fi
        # Provision defaults once. Restarting the binary must preserve an
        # operator's existing Dashboard/Accountability/Control Plane binding.
        # An explicit non-default service CP selector remains authoritative.
        case "$agent" in
            dashboard|accountability|control_plane)
                if [ "$agent" != control_plane ] || [ "$CONTROL_PLANE_MODEL_PROVIDER" = opencode.go_control_plane ]; then
                    current=$(threetched_config get "agents.$agent.model_provider" --json 2>/dev/null |
                        jq -r '.value // ""' 2>/dev/null || true)
                    if [ -n "$current" ]; then
                        printf '%s' "$current" | jq -Re 'test("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+[.][A-Za-z0-9_-]+$")' >/dev/null || {
                            echo 'tched-router: existing agent provider binding is invalid' >&2
                            exit 78
                        }
                        threetched_config get "providers.models.$current.model" --json |
                            jq -e '.value | strings | test("\\S")' >/dev/null || {
                            echo 'tched-router: existing selected provider is not configured' >&2
                            exit 78
                        }
                        agent_provider=$current
                    fi
                fi
                ;;
        esac
        existing=$(threetched_config get "providers.models.$kind.$profile.model" --json 2>/dev/null || true)
        created=true
        if printf '%s' "$existing" | jq -e '.value | type == "string" and length > 0' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            created=false
        fi
        threetched_config init "providers.models.$kind.$profile" >/dev/null
        # Dashboard is an existing Personal agent: preserve its selected provider,
        # skills, memory, risk profile and A2A settings.
        if [ "$agent" != dashboard ]; then
            for section in "agents.$agent" "agents.$agent.a2a" "agents.$agent.memory"; do
                threetched_config init "$section" >/dev/null
            done
        fi
        jq -n --arg p "/providers/models/$kind/$profile" --arg a "/agents/$agent" \
            --arg kind "$kind" --arg model "$model" --arg wire "$wire" \
            --arg provider "$agent_provider" --arg risk "$risk" \
            --argjson dashboard "$([ "$agent" = dashboard ] && echo true || echo false)" \
            --argjson created "$created" '
          (if $created then [{op:"add",path:($p+"/model"),value:$model}] else [] end) +
          (if $kind == "opencode" then [
           {op:"add",path:($p+"/uri"),value:"https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1"},
           {op:"add",path:($p+"/wire_api"),value:$wire},
           {op:"add",path:($p+"/native_tools"),value:false}
          ] else [
           {op:"add",path:($p+"/uri"),value:"https://opencode.ai/zen/go"}
          ] end) +
          [{op:"add",path:($a+"/model_provider"),value:$provider}] +
          (if $dashboard then [] else [
           {op:"add",path:($a+"/enabled"),value:true},
           {op:"add",path:($a+"/risk_profile"),value:$risk},
           {op:"add",path:($a+"/skill_bundles"),value:["default"]},
           {op:"add",path:($a+"/a2a/published"),value:true},
           {op:"add",path:($a+"/a2a/exposed_skills"),value:["plugin-schema"]},
           {op:"add",path:($a+"/memory/backend"),value:"none"}
          ] end)' | threetched_config patch - >/dev/null
    done <<'ROUTES'
    dashboard|opencode|glm-5.3-flash|chat_completions|dashboard
    accountability|opencode|glm-5.3-flash|chat_completions|accountability
    control_plane|opencode|glm-5.3-flash|chat_completions|control_plane
    cp_route_grok_47|opencode|grok-4.7|responses|control_plane
    cp_route_deepseek_v41_flash|opencode|deepseek-v4.1-flash|chat_completions|control_plane
    cp_route_glm_53_flash|opencode|glm-5.3-flash|chat_completions|control_plane
    cp_route_qwen38_flash|anthropic|qwen3.8-flash|messages|control_plane
    cp_route_gpt6_luna|opencode|gpt-6-luna|responses|control_plane
    cp_route_claude_fable_51|anthropic|claude-fable-5-1|messages|control_plane
    ROUTES
    
    # Routes whose models OpenCode Go does not serve stay configured but disabled.
    for agent in cp_route_nemotron_3_ultra cp_route_qwen3_coder_flash cp_route_gpt6_astra; do
        if threetched_config get "agents.$agent.enabled" --json >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            jq -n --arg p "/agents/$agent/enabled" '[{op:"add",path:$p,value:false}]' |
                threetched_config patch - >/dev/null
        fi
    done
    
    # Named agents use a runtime profile; the historical [agent] limit is inert.
    # The threetched CLI owns provisioning dynamic profile keys. Its HTTP init endpoint
    # only initializes schema sections and cannot create this map entry.
    # The profile owns max_tool_iterations. Preserve its configured value on restart;
    # fresh installations inherit the budget from the bootstrap configuration.
    threetched_config init runtime_profiles.chatbot_500 >/dev/null

    /** A fenced spec stays a spec. Plain text still mounts, as one text element. */
    export function replyPresentation(content: string) {
      const rendered = readCanvasResponse(content ?? "");
      if (rendered.canvasSpec) return rendered;
      const text = (rendered.content || content || "").trim().slice(0, 4000) || "The chatbot returned an empty reply.";
      try {
        const canvasSpec = validateCanvasSpec({
          root: "reply",
          elements: { reply: { type: "text", props: { text, className: null } } },
        });
        return { ...rendered, content: rendered.content || text, canvasSpec };
      } catch {
        return rendered;
      }
    }

    export async function currentControlPlaneModel(client: DoorClient, models: CatalogModel[], own?: boolean): Promise<RouteSelection> {

      const matches = models.filter((model) => model.available && model.model_id === modelId && model.control_plane_profile === reference && inferenceEndpointMatches(uri, model.inference_url_prefix));
      // Unmapped native selections remain visible as observed, never guessed.
      return { providerId: matches.length === 1 ? matches[0].provider_id : reference, modelId };
    }
    
    /**
     * Every mode uses the same provider-keyed Cozo catalog. The configured chatbot
     * uses its bounded own-model operation without elevation; other identities keep
     * the protected administration path. New methods require a matching reseal.
     */
    export async function setControlPlaneModel(
      client: DoorClient,
      selection: RouteSelection,
      models: CatalogModel[],
      elevate: Elevate,
    ): Promise<void> {
      const model = models.find((row) => row.provider_id === selection.providerId && row.model_id === selection.modelId);
      if (!model) throw new Error("That provider/model is no longer in the catalog. Refresh models.");
      if (!model.available) throw new Error("That catalog model is unavailable. Refresh models and choose an available model.");
      const reference = model.control_plane_profile;
      if (!reference) {
        throw new Error(`The catalog has no native routing binding for ${selection.providerId} / ${selection.modelId}.`);
      }
      const path = nativeProfilePath(reference, "model");
      const access = await controlPlaneModelAccess(client);
      if (access === "self") {
        try {
          const { result } = await client.call<{
            mode?: unknown; reference?: unknown; model?: unknown; uri?: unknown;
          }>(
            TCHED_ROUTER, "apply_own_agent_route",
            { provider_id: selection.providerId, model_id: selection.modelId },
            "cap.software.tched-router.agent.route.self.write@v1",
          );
          const applied = validateDedicatedRoute(result, "control_plane");
          if (applied.reference !== reference || applied.modelId !== selection.modelId) {
            throw new Error("The applied Control Plane route differs from the selected catalog model.");
          }
          assertInferenceEndpoint(applied.uri, model.inference_url_prefix);
          return;
        } catch (cause) {
          // No administrative fallback: a denial or lost response cannot turn the
          // scoped request into an unrelated broad configuration mutation.
          throw new ControlPlaneMutationUnconfirmedError(cause);
        }
      }
      const [currentReference, currentModel, uri] = await Promise.all([
        readRouterValue(client, CONTROL_PLANE_PROVIDER_PATH),
        readRouterValue(client, path),
        verifiedNativeUri(client, reference, model.inference_url_prefix),
      ]);
      if (currentReference === reference && currentModel === selection.modelId) return;
      const providerPointer = "/agents/control_plane/model_provider";
      const modelPointer = `/${path.replaceAll(".", "/")}`;
      const args = { operations: [
        { op: "test", path: providerPointer, value: currentReference },
        { op: "test", path: modelPointer, value: currentModel },
        { op: "test", path: `/${nativeProfilePath(reference, "uri").replaceAll(".", "/")}`, value: uri },
        { op: "replace", path: modelPointer, value: selection.modelId },
        { op: "replace", path: providerPointer, value: reference },
      ] };
      await elevate(TCHED_ROUTER, "config_patch", args);
      try {
        await client.call(TCHED_ROUTER, "config_patch", args, WRITE);
      } catch (cause) {
        // A lost response may follow an accepted write. Reconcile before retry;
        // preflight and elevation failures never reach this branch.
        throw new ControlPlaneMutationUnconfirmedError(cause);
      }
    }
    
    /** One-time sudo ticket for an exact protected call (elevation plugin). */
    export async function authorizeTask(
      client: DoorClient,
      plugin: string,
      method: string,
      args: Record<string, unknown>,
      password: string,
    ): Promise<void> {
      await client.call("elevation", "authorize_task", { plugin, method, args, password }, "elevation.authorize");
    }

    # Providers whose model lists the model_registry plugin keeps current.
    #
    # Installed root-owned at /etc/op-dbus/model-providers.toml. The list is the
    # owner's keyed inference providers: each names the variable in the owner's
    # ~/.bash_secrets its key comes from (key_env), and
    # `sudo scripts/install-provider-keys.sh` copies those keys into the
    # root-owned key files below. A provider whose key file is missing shows as a
    # failed refresh and offers no models.
    #
    # The control-plane chatbot calls model_registry.refresh hourly through its
    # lungs: each enabled provider is asked for its current models, new ones are
    # added, and models a provider stops listing stay in the catalog marked
    # unavailable. OpenCode and OpenRouter change their lists often, which is why
    # this is refreshed rather than written down.
    #
    # Fields: id (lowercase, digits, _), name, models_url (https), format
    # ("openai" or "anthropic" response shape), auth ("none", "bearer" or
    # "x_api_key"), key_file (root-owned 0400/0600 file directly under
    # /etc/op-dbus/secrets/, required unless auth = "none"), key_env (the
    # ~/.bash_secrets variable it is installed from), enabled (default true),
    # native_provider_id (the exact ordinary-selection family.alias, separate
    # from id), inference_url_prefix (the platform API namespace the route
    # checks require), and control_plane: the tched-router profile (family.alias)
    # that serves this provider's models for the Control Plane, plus any
    # alternative profiles the provider offers (another wire format on the same
    # provider). A key is only ever sent to its own provider.
    #
    # Credential gate (moved out of the retired ~/.bash_models flag file; TOML
    # syntax, one file). Each entry may declare `credential = "key" | "oauth" |
    # "off"` and, for oauth only, `credential_slot`. Slots are references, never
    # credential values: a keyed entry's slot is its key_env (or its key_file
    # when the key is installed directly, like opencode_go); an oauth entry's
    # slot is the native auth profile id (`family:profile`); an `off` entry
    # retains its key_env for the later re-enable. When `credential` is absent
    # the plain `enabled` flag governs (migration-safe). An `off` entry is hidden
    # and never refreshed; an `oauth` entry runs no keyed discovery (its rows
    # come from the native profile inventory, not the API key). Unknown class
    # text or a broken slot pairing fails the whole parse. The LLM maintains
    # these columns through model_registry.maintain_credentials.
    #
    # This file lists providers only. Models change constantly and are never
    # written here: the catalog holds them, and the control-plane LLM records per
    # model which of its provider's profiles it needs (model_registry
    # set_model_profile).
    
    # OpenCode Go. Its key is not in ~/.bash_secrets; it is installed directly as
    # /etc/op-dbus/secrets/opencode-api-key (the router already requires it).
    # Slot = key_file.
    [[providers]]
    id = "opencode_go"
    native_provider_id = "opencode.go_dashboard"
    inference_url_prefix = "https://opencode.ai/zen/go"
    name = "OpenCode Go"
    models_url = "https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models"
    format = "openai"
    auth = "bearer"
    key_file = "/etc/op-dbus/secrets/opencode-api-key"
    credential = "key"
    control_plane = { profile = "opencode.go_control_plane", alternatives = [
      "anthropic.go_control_plane_messages",
      "opencode.go_control_plane_responses",
    ] }
    
    [[providers]]
    id = "openrouter"
    inference_url_prefix = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
    name = "OpenRouter"
    models_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models"
    format = "openai"
    auth = "bearer"
    key_file = "/etc/op-dbus/secrets/openrouter-api-key"
    key_env = "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
    credential = "key"
    control_plane = { profile = "openrouter.control_plane" }

    #!/bin/sh
    # activate-golden.sh — the one command for deploying a new version.
    #
    #   sudo ./activate-golden.sh
    #
    # Run it after the release build and seal:
    #   CXXFLAGS="-include cstdint" cargo build --workspace --release
    #   sudo target/release/opblob seal-shm && sudo target/release/opblob persist
    # OP_RELEASE_DIR selects one prepared optimized artifact directory for both
    # release-controller verification and golden preparation (default target/release).
    #
    # What it does:
    # 1. Native provision-slots reconciles any interrupted transaction and prepares
    #    the owned golden/slot layout. Recovery-only work stops this invocation.
    # 2. Prepares /opt/op-dbus/golden from target/release and the sealed catalog
    #    (internal helper deploy/lib/golden/build-golden.sh; it never builds or seals).
    # 3. Native release sends/receives the immutable generation into the inactive
    #    slot, rotates read-only overlays at the inventory's owned host targets,
    #    and restores affected consumers' wanted states. Only active + previous remain.
    #
    # Undo the last release:
    #   sudo /usr/local/libexec/opdbus-release/op-release-launch rollback
    set -eu
    PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
    LC_ALL=C
    export PATH LC_ALL
    
    REPO=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$(readlink -f "$0")")" && pwd)
    OP_RELEASE_DIR=$(realpath -e -- "${OP_RELEASE_DIR:-"$REPO/target/release"}")
    export OP_RELEASE_DIR
    RELEASE_BASE=/usr/local/libexec/opdbus-release
    RELEASE_LAUNCH=$RELEASE_BASE/op-release-launch
    RELEASE_BIN=$RELEASE_BASE/op-release
    RELEASE_BOOT=/etc/init.d/op-release-activate
    
    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || { echo 'activate-golden.sh: run as root (sudo ./activate-golden.sh)' >&2; exit 1; }
    [ "$#" = 0 ] || { echo 'activate-golden.sh: takes no arguments' >&2; exit 1; }
    # Check the execution path before invoking any installed kit code. The launcher
    # independently checks the complete approved manifest and kernel/BTF pair.
    for directory in / /usr /usr/local /usr/local/libexec "$RELEASE_BASE" /etc /etc/init.d; do
        directory_mode=0$(stat -c %a "$directory")
        [ -d "$directory" ] && [ ! -L "$directory" ] &&
            [ "$(stat -c %u:%g "$directory")" = 0:0 ] &&
            [ "$((directory_mode & 07022))" -eq 0 ] ||
            { echo "activate-golden.sh: insecure release-kit directory: $directory" >&2; exit 1; }
    done
    for artifact in "$RELEASE_LAUNCH" "$RELEASE_BIN" "$RELEASE_BOOT"; do
        [ -f "$artifact" ] && [ ! -L "$artifact" ] &&
            [ "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a:%h "$artifact")" = 0:0:755:1 ] ||
            { echo "activate-golden.sh: install the approved root-owned release kit: $artifact" >&2; exit 1; }
    done
    cmp -s "$RELEASE_LAUNCH" "$REPO/deploy/release/op-release-launch" &&
        cmp -s "$RELEASE_BIN" "$OP_RELEASE_DIR/op-release" &&
        cmp -s "$RELEASE_BOOT" "$REPO/deploy/release/op-release-activate" ||
        { echo 'activate-golden.sh: installed release kit differs from this build; refusing an old or mixed kit' >&2; exit 1; }
    
    "$RELEASE_LAUNCH" provision-slots
    "$REPO/deploy/lib/golden/build-golden.sh"
    exec "$RELEASE_LAUNCH" release

    //! op-grpc-bridge — fresh, catalog-driven D-Bus <-> gRPC bridge.
    //!
    //! Design (from the wire contract in `proto/operation.proto` plus the
    //! plugin-catalog shape used by the SHM snapshots):
    //!
    //! - The **catalog** is the route source of truth: one entry per plugin
    //!   (`id`, `schema_hash`, declared `methods`, optional JSON `schema`).
    //! - The **catalog hash** stamped on every state frame is blake3 over the
    //!   sorted `(plugin_id, schema_hash)` pairs, exactly as `StateChange`
    //!   documents, so frames are self-describing without polling.
    //! - The **router** maps `(plugin_id, method)` to a synchronous handler.
    //!   Handlers are pure value-in/value-out; async or D-Bus-backed behavior
    //!   plugs in behind `BridgeCore` call sites, not inside the router.
    //! - The **core** owns the state store and an append-only hash-chained
    //!   journal. Every accepted mutation appends one journal event and
    //!   publishes one `StateChange` frame. `VerifyChain` recomputes the
    //!   chain, so audit needs no external store.
    //! - The **service** layer is a thin tonic translation of the three
    //!   proto services onto the core. `EventChainService` proof/snapshot
    //!   RPCs are honestly `UNIMPLEMENTED`; everything else is real.
    //!
    //! - OvsdbMirror, RuntimeMirror, ComponentRegistry, MailService, PrivacyNetworkService, DbusPassthrough — dropped, surface already covered by plugin state/catalog.
    //! - HookProvider — dropped from bridge, hooks move to the EMQX plugin (user-defined category field, separate work).
    //! - RegistrationService — dropped, super old, fresh start later.
    //!
    //! Deliberately gone (the old pollution): build-time live-host schema
    //! capture, generated per-plugin protos, chat-router/tched-router legacy,
    //! and the ~140 dispatch modules. Old files remain on disk unreferenced;
    //! remove them with `git rm` when convenient — they no longer compile
    //! into this crate (see `autobins`/`autotests` in Cargo.toml).

    pub mod catalog;
    pub mod core;
    pub mod grpc_client;
    pub mod grant_document;
    pub mod human_principal_registry;
    pub mod identity_binding;
    pub mod identity_receiver;
    pub mod mqtt_doorbell_relay;
    pub mod oracle_assertion;

    //! Fresh bridge binary: serves `StateSync`, `PluginService` and
    //! `EventChainService` (plus reflection) via [`op_grpc_bridge::serve`].
    //!
    //! Listen address: `OP_GRPC_BRIDGE_LISTEN`, else `OP_DBUS_GRPC_LISTEN`,
    //! else `0.0.0.0:50051`. Catalog source: `OP_BRIDGE_CATALOG` (path to a
    //! catalog JSON file), else an empty catalog.
    
    use std::net::SocketAddr;
    
    use op_grpc_bridge::core::BridgeCore;
    use op_grpc_bridge::Catalog;
    
    #[tokio::main]
    async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        let _ = rustls::crypto::aws_lc_rs::default_provider().install_default();
        tracing_subscriber::fmt()
            .with_env_filter(
                tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::try_from_default_env()
                    .unwrap_or_else(|_| tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::new("info")),
            )
            .init();
    
        let addr: SocketAddr = std::env::var("OP_GRPC_BRIDGE_LISTEN")
            .or_else(|_| std::env::var("OP_DBUS_GRPC_LISTEN"))
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "0.0.0.0:50051".to_string())
            .parse()?;
    
        let catalog = match std::env::var("OP_BRIDGE_CATALOG") {
            Ok(path) => Catalog::from_json_str(&std::fs::read_to_string(&path)?)?,
            Err(_) => Catalog::empty(),
        };
    
        tracing::info!(%addr, plugins = catalog.plugins().len(), "op-grpc-bridge starting");
        op_grpc_bridge::serve(addr, BridgeCore::new(catalog)).await
    }
    //! Thin tonic translation of the three core proto services onto [`BridgeCore`].
    //!
    //! `EventChainService` proof/snapshot RPCs are honestly `UNIMPLEMENTED`;
    //! everything else is real. `OvsdbMirror`, `RuntimeMirror` and
    //! `DbusPassthrough` are generated from the same file but not served: the
    //! fresh bridge owns state, plugins and audit only.
    
    use crate::core::{
        json_map_to_proto_struct, json_to_proto_value, proto_value_to_json, BridgeCore, CoreMutation,
        CoreOperation, CoreRejection, JournalEvent, MutationOutcome,
    };
    use crate::proto::event_chain_service_server::EventChainService;
    use crate::proto::plugin_service_server::PluginService;
    use crate::proto::state_sync_server::StateSync;
    use crate::proto::{
        BatchMutateRequest, BatchMutateResponse, CallMethodRequest, CallMethodResponse, ChainEvent,
        ChangeType, CreateSnapshotRequest, CreateSnapshotResponse, Decision, ErrorCode,
        GetEventsRequest, GetEventsResponse, GetProofRequest, GetProofResponse, GetPropertyRequest,
        GetPropertyResponse, GetSchemaRequest, GetSchemaResponse, GetSnapshotRequest,
        GetSnapshotResponse, GetStateRequest, GetStateResponse, ListPluginsResponse, MutateRequest,
        MutateResponse, MutationError, OperationType, PluginInfo, ProveTagImmutabilityRequest,
        ProveTagImmutabilityResponse, SearchSemanticTraceRequest, SearchSemanticTraceResponse,
        SemanticTraceMatch, SetPropertyRequest, SetPropertyResponse, Signal, StateChange,
        SubscribeEventsRequest, SubscribeRequest, SubscribeSignalsRequest, VerifyChainRequest,
        VerifyChainResponse,
    };
    use tokio::sync::{broadcast, mpsc};
    use tokio_stream::wrappers::ReceiverStream;
    use tonic::{Request, Response, Status};
    
    /// The three core services, backed by one [`BridgeCore`].
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub struct BridgeService {
        core: BridgeCore,
    }
    
    impl BridgeService {
        /// Serve `core` over tonic.
        pub fn new(core: BridgeCore) -> Self {
            Self { core }
        }
    }
    
    fn mutation_error(code: ErrorCode, message: String) -> MutationError {
        MutationError {
            code: code as i32,
            message,
            deny_reason: None,
        }
    }
    
    /// Translate one wire mutation. Infallible: anything malformed becomes a
    /// [`CoreOperation`] the core rejects at admission, so batch alignment
    /// never depends on translation order.
    fn core_mutation(req: &MutateRequest, actor_default: &str) -> CoreMutation {
        let operation = if req.operation == OperationType::SetProperty as i32 {
            CoreOperation::SetProperty
        } else if req.operation == OperationType::CallMethod as i32 {
            CoreOperation::CallMethod
        } else if req.operation == OperationType::ApplyPatch as i32 {
            CoreOperation::ApplyPatch
        } else {
            CoreOperation::Unknown
        };
        CoreMutation {
            plugin_id: req.plugin_id.clone(),
            object_path: req.object_path.clone(),
            operation,
            member_name: req.member_name.clone(),
            value: req
                .value
                .as_ref()
                .map(proto_value_to_json)
                .unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null),
            actor_id: if req.actor_id.is_empty() {
                actor_default.to_string()
            } else {
                req.actor_id.clone()
            },
            capability_id: req.capability_id.clone(),
            idempotency_key: req.idempotency_key.clone(),
        }
    }
    
    fn mutate_response(result: Result<MutationOutcome, CoreRejection>) -> MutateResponse {
        match result {
            Ok(outcome) => MutateResponse {
                success: true,
                event_id: outcome.event.event_id,
                event_hash: outcome.event.event_hash,
                result: outcome.result.as_ref().map(json_to_proto_value),
                error: None,
                effective_hash: outcome.event.result_effective_hash,
            },
            Err(rejection) => MutateResponse {
                success: false,
                event_id: 0,
                event_hash: String::new(),
                result: None,
                error: Some(mutation_error(rejection.code, rejection.message)),
                effective_hash: String::new(),
            },
        }
    }
    
    /// Tiny glob over bytes: `*` matches any run, `?` matches one byte.
    fn glob_match(pattern: &str, text: &str) -> bool {
        fn walk(pattern: &[u8], text: &[u8]) -> bool {
            if pattern.is_empty() {
                return text.is_empty();
            }
            match pattern[0] {
                b'*' => (0..=text.len()).any(|split| walk(&pattern[1..], &text[split..])),
                b'?' => !text.is_empty() && walk(&pattern[1..], &text[1..]),
                byte => !text.is_empty() && text[0] == byte && walk(&pattern[1..], &text[1..]),
            }
        }
        walk(pattern.as_bytes(), text.as_bytes())
    }
    
    fn state_matches(req: &SubscribeRequest, frame: &StateChange) -> bool {
        (req.plugin_ids.is_empty() || req.plugin_ids.contains(&frame.plugin_id))
            && (req.path_patterns.is_empty()
                || req
                    .path_patterns
                    .iter()
                    .any(|pattern| glob_match(pattern, &frame.object_path)))
            && (req.tags.is_empty()
                || frame
                    .tags_touched
                    .iter()
                    .any(|tag| req.tags.contains(tag)))
    }
    
    fn chain_matches(req: &SubscribeEventsRequest, event: &ChainEvent) -> bool {
        (req.plugin_id.is_empty() || event.plugin_id == req.plugin_id)
            && (req.tags.is_empty()
                || event
                    .tags_touched
                    .iter()
                    .any(|tag| req.tags.contains(tag)))
    }
    
    /// Event summary carried in each trace-match payload.
    fn event_payload(event: &JournalEvent) -> serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> {
        serde_json::Map::from_iter([
            ("event_id".to_string(), serde_json::json!(event.event_id)),
            (
                "event_hash".to_string(),
                serde_json::json!(event.event_hash),
            ),
            ("plugin_id".to_string(), serde_json::json!(event.plugin_id)),
            (
                "operation_type".to_string(),
                serde_json::json!(event.operation_type),
            ),
            ("target".to_string(), serde_json::json!(event.target)),
            ("actor_id".to_string(), serde_json::json!(event.actor_id)),
        ])
    }
    
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // StateSync
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    #[async_trait::async_trait]
    impl StateSync for BridgeService {
        type SubscribeStream = ReceiverStream<Result<StateChange, Status>>;
    
        async fn subscribe(
            &self,
            request: Request<SubscribeRequest>,
        ) -> Result<Response<Self::SubscribeStream>, Status> {
            let req = request.into_inner();
            // Register before returning the RPC, and snapshot under the same
            // commit boundary. No updates can fall between hydration and live.
            let (initial, schemas, mut sub) = self.core.state_subscription(
                req.include_initial_state,
                req.include_schema,
            );

    #!/bin/sh
    # build-golden.sh — prepare the golden btrfs subvolume from one release build.
    #
    # Rewritten 2026-10-29 (owner-directed, from scratch). Contract unchanged:
    # populate $OPDBUS_ROOT/golden (default /opt/op-dbus/golden) with the complete
    # deployable content, then let the deployment process snapshot/send/activate
    # it. This script never builds Rust, never seals the catalog, never writes
    # into the running host's installation and never restarts a service.
    #
    # Inputs (all must already exist; build/seal happen before this script):
    #   target/release/                 CXXFLAGS="-include cstdint" cargo build --workspace --release
    #   $OP_PERSISTED_CATALOG_SOURCE    sealed catalog from `opblob seal-shm && opblob persist`
    #                                   (default /var/lib/opdbus/plugin-blobs, never modified here)
    #   target/threetched-artifacts/    pinned threetched binary + provenance manifest
    #   /srv/git/3tched.com             the UI repository itself — Svelte/SvelteKit only.
    #                                   There is no vendored UI archive; assets are built
    #                                   from this repo (overridable with OP_UI_REPO).
    #   /var/cache/op-dbus/...          pinned EMQX and NotebookLM wheel artifacts.
    #
    # Layout created under golden/:
    #   bin/                            release binaries
    #   libexec/3tched/                 explicit provisioning helpers/assets
    #   usr/bin/threetched              pinned threetched dependency
    #   usr/share/op-dbus/              immutable config, catalog, graphs, provenance
    #   usr/local/share/op-dbus/dashboard/  UI assets built from the UI repo, at root
    #   sv/<service>/run                enabled application runit definitions
    #   opt/                            immutable broker, provider, python runtimes
    #   MANIFEST                        commit, build time, sha256 per binary, graph pin
    # Host secrets, grants, network/bootstrap services and writable data are excluded.
    #
    # Usage:
    #   build-golden.sh                 # prepare and validate golden (default)
    #   build-golden.sh --golden-only   # compatibility alias for the default
    #   build-golden.sh --dry-run       # validate inputs and print planned changes
    # Retired options --system, --live-only and --no-restart fail explicitly.
    # Requires root for the live run (the UI build itself drops to the repo owner).
    set -eu
    
    OPDBUS_ROOT=${OPDBUS_ROOT:-/opt/op-dbus}
    OPDBUS_ROOT=$(realpath -e -- "$OPDBUS_ROOT")
    GOLDEN_DIR="$OPDBUS_ROOT/golden"
    DRY_RUN=0
    
    SCRIPT_PATH=$(readlink -f "$0" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$0")
    # Internal helper of ./activate-golden.sh; every relative input lives in deploy/runit.
    SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$SCRIPT_PATH")/../../runit" && pwd)
    if [ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../Cargo.toml" ]; then
        PROJECT_ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
    else
        PROJECT_ROOT=${OP_DBUS_ROOT:-$(pwd)}
    fi
    RELEASE_DIR=$(realpath -e -- "${OP_RELEASE_DIR:-"$PROJECT_ROOT/target/release"}")
    PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR=${OP_PERSISTED_CATALOG_SOURCE:-/var/lib/opdbus/plugin-blobs}
    PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR=$(realpath -e -- "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR")
    case "$PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR" in
        "$GOLDEN_DIR"|"$GOLDEN_DIR"/*)
            printf '%s\n' "catalog source must be outside the golden preparation tree" >&2
            exit 1 ;;
    esac
    
    UI_REPO=${OP_UI_REPO:-/srv/git/3tched.com}
    UI_REPO=$(realpath -e -- "$UI_REPO")
    UI_DIST="$UI_REPO/dist"
    THREETCHED_ARTIFACT_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/target/threetched-artifacts/tched-router"
    THREETCHED_BIN="$THREETCHED_ARTIFACT_DIR/threetched"
    THREETCHED_MANIFEST="$THREETCHED_ARTIFACT_DIR/manifest.json"
    TCHED_ROUTER_SOURCE_PIN="$PROJECT_ROOT/vendor/tched-router/source.pin"
    EMQX_VERSION_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/emqx.version"
    EMQX_CONFIG_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/../emqx"
    ARTIFACT_CACHE_DIR=${OP_ARTIFACT_CACHE_DIR:-/var/cache/op-dbus/source-artifacts}
    MCP_AUDIENCE_POLICY_SOURCE="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/mcp-audience-policy.json"
    HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGES_SOURCE="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/host-runtime-packages.txt"
    EXECUTION_PYTHON_LOCK="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/execution-python-requirements.lock"
    EXECUTION_PYTHON_PREPARE="$SCRIPT_DIR/prepare-execution-python.sh"
    HOST_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_CHECK="$SCRIPT_DIR/check-host-runtime-packages.sh"
    TCHED_ROUTER_BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/threetched-runtime.toml"
    TCHED_ROUTER_BOOTSTRAP_SKILLS="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/threetched-skills/default"
    AGENT_BUNDLE_SOURCE="$SCRIPT_DIR/../config/agents"
    RETIRED_SERVICES_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/retired-services"
    RETIRED_BINARIES_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/retired-binaries"
    
    # Explicit source -> release-name inventory, relative to deploy/. Never copy
    # the whole host helper directory: network/storage bootstrap stays independent.
    RELEASE_HELPER_INPUTS='0755 runit/libexec-3tched/emqx-prepare emqx-prepare
    0755 runit/libexec-3tched/runit-ready-signal runit-ready-signal
    0755 runit/libexec-3tched/prepare-salad-control-plane prepare-salad-control-plane
    0755 runit/libexec-3tched/opdbus-rundirs-up opdbus-rundirs-up
    0755 runit/libexec-3tched/mount-3tchedfs mount-3tchedfs
    0755 scripts/provision-workspace-subscriber.sh provision-workspace-subscriber
    0755 scripts/prepare-instance-disk.sh prepare-instance-disk
    0755 scripts/sync-instance-upgrade.sh sync-instance-upgrade
    0755 scripts/prepare-chatbot-adoption.sh prepare-chatbot-adoption
    0755 scripts/bind-instance-root.sh bind-instance-root
    0755 scripts/3tchedfs-invoke.sh 3tchedfs-invoke
    0755 runit/libexec-3tched/op-identity-root op-identity-root
    0755 runit/libexec-3tched/op-identity-image op-identity-image
    0755 runit/libexec-3tched/attach-host-workspace-folders attach-host-workspace-folders
    0755 runit/libexec-3tched/restore-chatbot-root restore-chatbot-root
    0755 workspace-image/prepare-lungs-client.sh prepare-lungs-client
    0755 workspace-image/3tchedfs-mount-preflight 3tchedfs-mount-preflight

    #!/bin/sh
    # Installed base-system launcher; holds one open-file-description lock through exec.
    # Base-installation authorization contract (never installed by this launcher):
    # /usr/local/libexec/opdbus-release is root:root 0755, outside every application
    # overlay, containing ONLY op-release, op-release-launch and manifest.sha256.
    # The executables and /etc/init.d/op-release-activate are root:root 0755 regular
    # single-link files. The manifest is root:root 0600, with exactly one canonical
    # SHA256 line ("<64 lowercase hex>  <absolute path>") for each of those THREE
    # executables, including the init script outside this directory. No self-entry.
    # Authorize those bytes together from the independently authored op-deployment
    # op-release build and these two source scripts; never approve a historical
    # controller by copying or renaming it. Publish the manifest only after review
    # of the complete installed set, with release/boot callers inactive during the
    # base installation. This is root approval, not a remotely signed provenance
    # claim. No generated manifest, fallback, or live installation is performed here.
    # Existing receiver.json, first-activation.json and native lifetime gates remain
    # separate authorities; this kit neither creates nor relaxes them.
    set -eu
    PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
    LC_ALL=C
    export PATH LC_ALL
    umask 077
    base=/usr/local/libexec/opdbus-release
    state=/var/lib/opdbus-release
    runtime=/run/opdbus-release
    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || { echo 'usage: op-release-launch {release|deploy|provision-slots|status|activate a|b|rollback|abort|boot}' >&2; exit 2; }
    verb=$1
    case "$verb" in
      activate) [ "$#" -eq 2 ] && { [ "$2" = a ] || [ "$2" = b ]; } || exit 2 ;;
      release|deploy|provision-slots|status|rollback|abort|boot) [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || exit 2 ;;
      *) echo 'unsupported release verb; host/Incus provisioning belongs to its existing owner' >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
    # Independently authored, read-only release-kit verifier. It intentionally has
    # no shell-source dependency and knows no storage daemon, guard tool or helper.
    fail() { printf 'op-release-launch: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
    secure_directory() {
        [ -d "$1" ] && [ ! -L "$1" ] &&
            [ "$(stat -c %u:%g "$1")" = 0:0 ] &&
            [ "$((0$(stat -c %a "$1") & 07022))" -eq 0 ] ||
            fail "insecure directory: $1"
    }
    secure_file() {
        [ -f "$1" ] && [ ! -L "$1" ] &&
            [ "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a:%h "$1")" = "0:0:$2:1" ] ||
            fail "expected root-owned, non-symlink, single-link mode $2 file: $1"
    }
    verify_release_kit() {
        for directory in / /usr /usr/local /usr/local/libexec "$base" /etc /etc/init.d; do
            secure_directory "$directory"
        done
        [ "$(stat -c %a "$base")" = 755 ] || fail 'release-kit directory must be mode 0755'
        secure_file "$base/op-release" 755
        secure_file "$base/op-release-launch" 755
