    fn absolute_env_path(name: &str, default: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
        let path = std::env::var_os(name)
            .map(PathBuf::from)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(default));
        ensure!(path.is_absolute(), "{name} must be an absolute path");
        Ok(path)
    }
    
    pub fn binary() -> Result<PathBuf> {
        absolute_env_path("THREETCHED_BIN", DEFAULT_BINARY)
    }
    
    pub fn config_dir() -> Result<PathBuf> {
        Ok(PathBuf::from(DEFAULT_CONFIG_DIR))
    }
    
    pub fn manifest() -> Result<PathBuf> {
        absolute_env_path("THREETCHED_MANIFEST", DEFAULT_MANIFEST)
    }
    
    /// Select the binary and provenance manifest used only to capture the sealed
    /// CLI contract. Runtime dispatch continues to use [`binary`] and [`manifest`].
    /// Build/seal invocations may point these selectors at a not-yet-installed
    /// candidate, but must supply the pair together so provenance cannot drift.
    pub(crate) fn capture_paths() -> Result<(PathBuf, PathBuf)> {
        match (
            std::env::var_os("THREETCHED_CAPTURE_BIN"),
            std::env::var_os("THREETCHED_CAPTURE_MANIFEST"),
        ) {
            (None, None) => Ok((binary()?, manifest()?)),
            (Some(binary), Some(manifest)) => {
                let binary = PathBuf::from(binary);
                let manifest = PathBuf::from(manifest);
                ensure!(binary.is_absolute(), "THREETCHED_CAPTURE_BIN must be an absolute path");
                ensure!(manifest.is_absolute(), "THREETCHED_CAPTURE_MANIFEST must be an absolute path");
                Ok((binary, manifest))
            }
            _ => anyhow::bail!("THREETCHED_CAPTURE_BIN and THREETCHED_CAPTURE_MANIFEST must be supplied together"),
        }
    }

    fn seal_plugins(dir: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
        op_plugins::state_plugins::threetched::prepare_schema_capture()
            .map_err(|error| format!("capture threetched schema before sealing: {error:#}"))?;
        let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()
            .enable_all()
            .build()
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let registry = DefaultPluginRegistry::new(Arc::new(MemoryStore::new()));
        let plugins = rt
            .block_on(registry.load_all_plugins())
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    
        let mut candidates = Vec::new();
        let mut missing_schema = Vec::new();
        for plugin in plugins {
            let plugin_id = plugin.name().to_string();
            // Prefer a live-probed schema (real backend reachability folded in)
            // over the static declaration; most plugins have nothing to probe
            // and schema_live() defaults to None, in which case schema() is used.
            let live = rt.block_on(plugin.schema_live());
            let schema = match live.or_else(|| plugin.schema()) {
                Some(schema) => schema,
                None => {
                    missing_schema.push(plugin_id);
                    continue;
                }
            };
            candidates.push(try_blobify_plugin_schema(&plugin_id, schema)?);
        }
    
        // Validate every schema before opening or changing the active catalog.
        // Publication I/O can still fail; this is not a filesystem transaction.
        let mut cat = ActiveReflectionCatalog::open(dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let sealed = candidates.len();
        let mut sealed_ids = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        for blob in candidates {
            sealed_ids.insert(blob.manifest.plugin_id.clone());
            let path = cat.upsert_blob(&blob).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            println!(
                "sealed    {}  ({} methods, schema {})",
                path.display(),
                blob.manifest.methods.len(),
                &blob.manifest.schema_hash[..16]
            );
        }
    
        // A blob in the catalog IS the plugin: sweep blobs whose plugin no
        // longer exists in the build (deregistration by disappearance).
        let mut swept = cat.retain_plugins(&sealed_ids).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        swept.sort();

    #!/bin/sh
    # Sourced by build-golden.sh; uses its bounded install_file/remove_owned helpers.
    # Reads prepared artifacts and source inputs only, never live destinations.
    validate_system_inputs() {
        for input in "$RELEASE_DIR/op-release" \
            "$PROJECT_ROOT/deploy/release/op-release-launch" \
            "$PROJECT_ROOT/deploy/release/op-release-activate"; do
            [ -f "$input" ] && [ ! -L "$input" ] && [ -r "$input" ] ||
                die "missing or non-regular system payload input: $input"
        done
    }
    
    clear_system_payload() {
        # Remove the declaration first so interrupted preparation cannot retain an
        # apparently usable old manifest. These paths are preparation-owned only.
        for old in "$GOLDEN_DIR/system-files.json" "$GOLDEN_DIR/system"; do
            if [ -e "$old" ] || [ -L "$old" ]; then
                remove_owned "$old"
            fi
        done
    }
    
    stage_system_payload() (
        validate_system_inputs
        clear_system_payload
        if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then
            printf '%s\n' '  would stage four explicit system files and their digest manifest'
            exit 0
        fi
        scratch=$(mktemp -d "$GOLDEN_DIR/.system-payload.XXXXXX")
        trap 'rm -rf -- "$scratch"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
        entries=$scratch/entries.jsonl
        kit_manifest=$scratch/manifest.sha256
        : > "$entries"
        : > "$kit_manifest"
        stage_entry() {
            mode=$1 input=$2 source=$3 destination=$4 absent=$5
            install_file "$mode" "$input" "$GOLDEN_DIR/$source"
            digest=$(sha256sum "$GOLDEN_DIR/$source")
            digest=${digest%% *}
            jq -n --arg source "$source" --arg path "$destination" \
                --arg sha256 "$digest" --argjson mode "$((mode))" \
                --argjson absent "$absent" \
                '{source:$source,path:$path,sha256:$sha256,mode:$mode} +
                 (if $absent then {install_if_absent:true} else {} end)' >> "$entries"
        }
        stage_kit_file() {
            stage_entry 0755 "$1" "system/release/$2" "$3" false
            printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$3" >> "$kit_manifest"
        }
        stage_kit_file "$RELEASE_DIR/op-release" op-release \
            /usr/local/libexec/opdbus-release/op-release
        stage_kit_file "$PROJECT_ROOT/deploy/release/op-release-launch" op-release-launch \
            /usr/local/libexec/opdbus-release/op-release-launch
        stage_kit_file "$PROJECT_ROOT/deploy/release/op-release-activate" op-release-activate \
            /etc/init.d/op-release-activate
        # Publish authorization bytes last in the native transaction's apply order.
        stage_entry 0600 "$kit_manifest" system/release/manifest.sha256 \
            /usr/local/libexec/opdbus-release/manifest.sha256 false
        jq -s '{version:1,files:.}' "$entries" > "$scratch/system-files.json"
        install_file 0644 "$scratch/system-files.json" "$GOLDEN_DIR/system-files.json"
    )

    [Unit]
    Description=Process designated chat response turn %i
    Requires=3tchedfs.service threetchedfs.service
    After=3tchedfs.service threetchedfs.service
    ConditionPathIsMountPoint=/run/mount/3tchedfs
    ConditionPathIsMountPoint=/run/mount/threetched
    
    [Service]
    Type=oneshot
    User=root
    Group=root
    ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/op-chat-responder --turn-id %i
    TimeoutStartSec=600s
    TimeoutStopSec=10s
    KillSignal=SIGTERM
    Restart=no
    #!/bin/sh
    exec 2>&1
    set -eu
    
    # Out-of-band chat responder: subscribes to responder wake topic and
    # answers pending chat turns via the 3tchedFS lungs mount.
    
    wait_dep() {
        sv start "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        i=0
        until sv check "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
            i=$((i+1))
            [ "$i" -ge 90 ] && { echo "dependency $1 not ready after 90s" >&2; exit 1; }
            sleep 1
        done
    }
    
    # Dependencies: the gRPC bridge must be running (owns the turn registry),
    # EMQX must be running (for MQTT wake subscription), and the chatbot's
    # identity roots must be mounted (for 3tchedFS access).
    wait_dep op-grpc-bridge
    wait_dep emqx
    wait_dep identity-roots
    
    set -a
    [ -r /etc/op-dbus/environment ] && . /etc/op-dbus/environment
    set +a
    
    # The control-plane chatbot's service identity. This responder answers
    # turns designated to this principal.
    RESPONDER_PRINCIPAL_ID="${OP_CONTROL_PLANE_CHATBOT_PRINCIPAL_ID:-1262e982-14c1-44d4-0771-7ce74213211b}"
    
    # The 3tchedFS lungs mount for this chatbot identity.
    LUNGS_MOUNT="${OP_CHAT_RESPONDER_LUNGS_MOUNT:-/opt/run-mounts/3tched}"
    
    # MQTT broker (private loopback backend).
    MQTT_HOST="${OP_CHAT_RESPONDER_MQTT_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"
    MQTT_PORT="${OP_CHAT_RESPONDER_MQTT_PORT:-1883}"
    
    export RUST_LOG="${OP_CHAT_RESPONDER_LOG:-info,rumqttc=warn}"
    
    # Wait for the lungs mount to be available.
    i=0
    while [ ! -d "$LUNGS_MOUNT/chat_response" ]; do
        i=$((i+1))
        if [ "$i" -ge 60 ]; then
            echo "3tchedFS lungs mount not available at $LUNGS_MOUNT after 60s" >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        sleep 1
    done
    
    args="--principal-id $RESPONDER_PRINCIPAL_ID"
    args="$args --lungs-mount $LUNGS_MOUNT"
    args="$args --mqtt-host $MQTT_HOST"
    args="$args --mqtt-port $MQTT_PORT"
    
    exec /usr/local/bin/op-chat-responder $args

    //! Out-of-band chat responder wake relay for OP-DBUS.
    //!
    //! This service monitors for pending chat turns via the responder's MQTT wake
    //! topic (`opdbus/responder-wake/<sha256(principal_id)>`) and forwards them
    //! to the control-plane chatbot via D-Bus. The actual response generation
    //! happens in the chatbot; this service only ensures the chatbot is notified
    //! of pending work.
    //!
    //! MQTT wake delivery is required. There is no pending-turn scan or timer retry.
    //! A transport failure terminates the relay explicitly; a missing publication
    //! cannot be inferred from an idle subscription and requires producer-side evidence.
    
    use anyhow::{Context, Result};
    use clap::Parser;
    use rumqttc::{AsyncClient, Event, MqttOptions, Packet, QoS};
    use serde::Deserialize;
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    use std::time::Duration;
    use tracing::{debug, error, info, warn};

    struct Args {
        /// Principal ID of this responder (chatbot container identity).
        #[arg(long, env = "RESPONDER_PRINCIPAL_ID")]
        principal_id: String,
    
        /// Path to the 3tchedFS lungs mount.
        #[arg(long, env = "LUNGS_MOUNT", default_value = "/opt/run-mounts/3tched")]
        lungs_mount: PathBuf,
    
        /// MQTT broker host.
        #[arg(long, env = "MQTT_HOST", default_value = "127.0.0.1")]
        mqtt_host: String,
    
        /// MQTT broker port.
        #[arg(long, env = "MQTT_PORT", default_value = "1883")]
        mqtt_port: u16,
    
        /// D-Bus destination for the chatbot notification.
        #[arg(
            long,
            env = "DBUS_CHATBOT_DEST",
            default_value = "org.opdbus.v1.plugins.ctl_plane_chatbot"
        )]
        dbus_dest: String,
    
        /// D-Bus object path for the chatbot.
        #[arg(
            long,
            env = "DBUS_CHATBOT_PATH",
            default_value = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/ctl_plane_chatbot"
        )]
        dbus_path: String,
    }
    
    /// The responder wake message published by the bridge.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
    struct ResponderWake {

    //! One local D-Bus lungs transport with kernel-authenticated container callers.
    //!
    //! Host root in the bridge's own user and PID namespaces may `Bind(session_id)`
    //! for the host FUSE mounts. Guests instead call `BindCurrentContainer()` with
    //! no identity input. Their kernel peer PID must belong to exactly one running,
    //! committed identity container. Every operation revalidates that native
    //! instance UUID, init process, peer process, namespaces and current principal.
    //! No credential is copied into a guest, and UID alone never selects identity.
    
    use std::fs::File;
    use std::os::fd::{AsRawFd, FromRawFd, OwnedFd};
    use std::os::unix::fs::{FileTypeExt as _, MetadataExt as _, PermissionsExt as _};
    use std::path::Path;
    use std::sync::{Arc, OnceLock};
    use std::time::Duration;
    
    use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
    use op_plugins::state_plugins::identity_sled::ContainerIdentitySled;
    use op_plugins::state_plugins::incus::{IncusInstance, IncusPlugin, IncusRootRepairBackend};
    use zbus::connection::AuthMechanism;
    
    use crate::dbus_identity::{authoritative_session_identity, DbusIdentityError};
    use crate::interceptor::GhostbridgeIdentity;
    use crate::mutation_engine::MutationEngine;
    use crate::schema_router::SchemaRouter;
    
    pub const DEFAULT_LUNGS_SOCKET: &str = "/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock";
    pub const LUNGS_OBJECT_PATH: &str = "/org/opdbus/v1/lungs";
    const NEGOTIATION_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);

    /// This fd refers to the socket's original peer, even after its numeric PID is
    /// recycled. Opening a pidfd by that numeric PID would already be too late.
    struct PeerLifetime(OwnedFd);
    
    impl PeerLifetime {
        fn from_socket(socket: &impl AsRawFd) -> Result<Self> {
            let mut fd: libc::c_int = -1;
            let mut length = std::mem::size_of_val(&fd) as libc::socklen_t;
            // SAFETY: both output pointers refer to live, correctly sized values;
            // the borrowed socket remains open throughout this call.
            let result = unsafe {
                libc::getsockopt(
                    socket.as_raw_fd(),
                    libc::SOL_SOCKET,
                    libc::SO_PEERPIDFD,
                    (&mut fd as *mut libc::c_int).cast(),
                    &mut length,
                )
            };
            if result != 0 {
                return Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error())
                    .context("socket peer lifetime unavailable");
            }
            ensure!(fd >= 0, "socket peer lifetime unavailable");
            // SAFETY: successful SO_PEERPIDFD returns a new owned, close-on-exec fd.
            let lifetime = Self(unsafe { OwnedFd::from_raw_fd(fd) });
            ensure!(
                length as usize == std::mem::size_of_val(&fd),
                "invalid socket peer lifetime"
            );
            lifetime.ensure_alive()?;
            Ok(lifetime)
        }
    
        fn ensure_alive(&self) -> Result<()> {
            let mut descriptor = libc::pollfd {
                fd: self.0.as_raw_fd(),
                events: libc::POLLIN,
                revents: 0,
            };
            // SAFETY: descriptor is a live pollfd; timeout zero cannot block.
            let result = unsafe { libc::poll(&mut descriptor, 1, 0) };
            if result < 0 {
                return Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error())
                    .context("socket peer lifetime unavailable");
            }
            ensure!(result == 0 && descriptor.revents == 0, "socket peer exited");
            Ok(())
        }
    
        fn read_process(&self, pid: u32) -> Result<ProcessIdentity> {
            self.ensure_alive()?;
            let process = ProcessIdentity::read(pid)?;
            self.ensure_alive()?;
            Ok(process)
        }
    
        fn revalidate(&self, process: &ProcessIdentity) -> Result<()> {
            self.ensure_alive()?;
            process.revalidate()?;
            self.ensure_alive()
        }
    }

        async fn bind(&self, session_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
            let _bootstrap = self.bootstrap.lock().await;
            self.revalidate_peer()?;

            ensure!(
                valid_session_id(session_id),

        async fn bind_current_container(&self) -> Result<()> {
            let _bootstrap = self.bootstrap.lock().await;
            self.revalidate_peer()?;
            ensure!(
                self.binding.get().is_none(),
                "this lungs connection is already bound"
            );
            // A host process cannot claim a guest by choosing its shared mapped UID.
            ensure!(
                self.peer.pid_namespace != self.host.pid_namespace,
                "host process has no container binding"
            );
            self.revalidate_peer()?;
            let sessions = crate::identity_sled_dispatch::all_sessions(self.engine.as_ref()).await?;
            let mut candidates = Vec::new();
            for sled in sessions
                .iter()
                .filter(|sled| sled.active && sled.is_anchored())
            {
                if let Ok(binding) = self.container_binding(sled).await {
                    candidates.push(binding);
                }
            }
            let binding = exactly_one(candidates)?;
            self.publish_binding(Binding::Container(binding)).await
        }
    }
    
    fn instance_uuid(instance: &IncusInstance) -> Result<String> {
        let value = instance

            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|config| config.get("volatile.uuid"))
            .context("native instance UUID unavailable")?;
        ensure!(

            "native instance UUID is invalid"
        );
        Ok(value.clone())
    }

            && pinned.session_genesis == current.session_genesis
            && pinned.native_name == current.native_name
            && pinned.native_uuid == current.native_uuid
            && pinned.init == current.init
    }

    //! Shared strict Cozo-backed principal lookup for authenticated receivers.
    
    use std::collections::HashMap;
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};
    
    use anyhow::{anyhow, bail};
    use op_cozo_store::{CozoGraphShuttle, HumanPrincipalRecord, human_principal_cozo_db_path};
    
    fn stores() -> &'static Mutex<HashMap<PathBuf, CozoGraphShuttle>> {
        static STORES: OnceLock<Mutex<HashMap<PathBuf, CozoGraphShuttle>>> = OnceLock::new();
        STORES.get_or_init(|| Mutex::new(HashMap::new()))
    }
    
    pub(crate) fn store() -> Option<CozoGraphShuttle> {
        let path = human_principal_cozo_db_path();
        let mut map = stores()
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|poisoned| poisoned.into_inner());
        if let Some(existing) = map.get(&path) {
            return Some(existing.clone());
        }
        match CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path.clone()) {
            Ok(shuttle) => {
                map.insert(path, shuttle.clone());
                Some(shuttle)
            }
            Err(error) => {
                tracing::warn!(path = %path.display(), %error, "human principal Cozo store unavailable");
                None
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Used by the retained external MCP integration when that module is linked.
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    pub(crate) fn external_mcp_store() -> anyhow::Result<CozoGraphShuttle> {
        store().ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("human principal Cozo store unavailable"))
    }

        pubkey: &str,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<Option<HumanPrincipalRecord>> {
        let Some(cozo) = store() else {
            bail!("human principal store unavailable");
        };
        lookup_in(cozo, pubkey).await
    }

        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || cozo.get_human_principal_by_pubkey(&pubkey))
            .await
            .map_err(|error| anyhow!("human principal pubkey lookup join: {error}"))?
            .map_err(|error| anyhow!("human principal pubkey lookup: {error}"))
    }

    pub(crate) async fn activate_human_session_on_login(
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        session_id: &str,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        let Some(sled) = stored_session(engine, session_id).await? else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        if sled.principal_kind.as_deref() != Some("human") || sled.instance.is_none() || sled.active {
            return Ok(());
        }
        activate_session(engine, session_id).await?;
        tracing::info!(session_id, "started human identity container on login");
        Ok(())
    }

    //! Shared SID1 checks. These checks alone do not authenticate an identity:
    //! callers must obtain the record from committed private state and verify its
    //! provisioned container or human binding before accepting the request.
    
    use base64::Engine as _;
    use op_identity::sealed_id::SealedId;
    use op_plugins::state_plugins::identity_sled::ContainerIdentitySled;
    
    /// Decode the authored envelope and verify its transport and derived IDs.
    pub fn parse_for_transport(wire: &[u8], transport: &str) -> Result<SealedId, String> {
        let claims = SealedId::open(wire).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
        if claims.principal_kind != "wireguard-principal"
            || !claims
                .transport_scope
                .split(',')
                .any(|scope| scope.trim() == transport)
        {
            return Err(format!(
                "sealed identity is not valid for the {transport} transport"
            ));
        }
        if op_identity::session::derive_session_id(&claims.wireguard_pubkey) != claims.session_id
            || op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&claims.wireguard_pubkey)
                != claims.principal_id
        {
            return Err(
                "sealed identity identifiers do not match its WARP-transported identity".into(),
            );
        }
        Ok(claims)
    }
    
    /// Compare claims with a record already read from the committed private projection.
    /// This does not verify the record's container or human binding.
    pub fn match_committed_session(
        wire: &[u8],
        sled: &ContainerIdentitySled,
        transport: &str,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<SealedId, String> {
        let claims = parse_for_transport(wire, transport)?;
        if !sled.is_anchored()
            || sled
                .expires_at
                .is_some_and(|expiry| expiry != 0 && expiry <= now)
        {
            return Err("sealed identity session is unanchored or expired".into());
        }
        let inline = format!(
            "{}{}",
            op_identity::sealed_id::INLINE_PREFIX,
            base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(wire)
        );
        if sled.session_id != claims.session_id
            || sled.sealed_id.as_deref() != Some(inline.as_str())
            || sled.wireguard_pubkey != claims.wireguard_pubkey
            || sled.genesis.as_deref() != Some(claims.session_genesis.as_str())
            || sled.trace_id != claims.trace_id
            || sled.schema_version != claims.schema_version
            || sled.expires_at.unwrap_or(0) != claims.expires_at
            || sled.arrival_timestamp != claims.arrival_timestamp
            || claims.issued_at != claims.arrival_timestamp
            || sled.chain_head_at_arrival != claims.chain_head_at_arrival
            || sled.catalog_hash_at_arrival != claims.catalog_hash_at_arrival
            || sled.head_timestamp_at_arrival != claims.head_timestamp_at_arrival
        {
            return Err("sealed identity does not match the authoritative sled".into());
        }
        Ok(claims)
    }
    
    /// Check a record from the authoritative private projection, including its
    /// human or container binding. The caller must establish that the supplied
    /// record came from that projection and that its sealed contract is current.
    pub fn match_bound_session(
        wire: &[u8],
        sled: &ContainerIdentitySled,
        transport: &str,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<SealedId, String> {
        if !crate::identity_binding::identity_session_binding_matches(sled) {
            return Err("sealed identity has no matching provisioned container binding".into());
        }
        match_committed_session(wire, sled, transport, now)
    }

        fn checks_transport_and_exact_committed_session() {

            parse_for_transport(&wire, "grpc").unwrap();
            assert!(parse_for_transport(&wire, "mcp").is_err());
            assert!(match_committed_session(&wire, &sled, "grpc", 150).is_ok());
            assert!(match_bound_session(&wire, &sled, "grpc", 150).is_err());
            sled.principal_kind = Some("human".into());
            assert!(match_bound_session(&wire, &sled, "grpc", 150).is_ok());
            assert!(match_committed_session(&wire, &sled, "grpc", 200).is_err());
            sled.session_id = "other".into();
            assert!(match_committed_session(&wire, &sled, "grpc", 150).is_err());
            let mut corrupted = wire.clone();
            *corrupted.last_mut().unwrap() ^= 1;
            assert!(parse_for_transport(&corrupted, "grpc").is_err());
        }
    }

    fn authenticate_sid1_grpc(mut req: Request<()>, wire: &[u8]) -> Result<Request<()>, Status> {
        let engine =
            engine_handle().ok_or_else(|| Status::internal("MutationEngine Memory Unreachable"))?;
        let claims = tokio::task::block_in_place(|| {
            tokio::runtime::Handle::current().block_on(

            )

        .map_err(Status::unauthenticated)?;
        // SID1 proves the sled binding, not that its key remains authorized.

        let principal_id = resolve_active_principal_id(&claims.wireguard_pubkey)?;
        if principal_id != claims.principal_id {
            return Err(Status::unauthenticated(
                "Sealed identity does not match the registered principal",
            ));

            session_id: claims.session_id,
            expires_at: claims.expires_at,
            session_genesis: claims.session_genesis,
        });
        Ok(req)
    }

    //! Responder wake: notifies designated responders of pending requests.
    //!
    //! When a human opens a chat turn (or any request via RequestRegistry),
    //! the designated responder principal needs to be notified so it can claim
    //! and fulfill the request. This module provides that notification channel.
    //!
    //! The responder wake is separate from the human's doorbell wake:
    //! - Human doorbell: `opdbus/wake/<sha256(principal)>` — notifies the human
    //!   that their scope has new content (e.g., an agent's response)
    //! - Responder wake: `opdbus/responder-wake/<sha256(responder_principal)>` —
    //!   notifies an agent that a request awaits their response
    //!
    //! Payload includes the request_id so the responder can claim it.
    
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    
    /// A responder wake notification: tells the designated responder that a
    /// request awaits their response.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub(crate) struct ResponderWake {
        /// The request ID the responder should claim.
        pub request_id: String,
        /// Owner key of the requester (for routing the response back).
        pub owner_key: String,
        /// Principal ID of the requester (for response scope).
        pub owner_principal_id: String,
        /// Conversation ID (for chat turns).
        #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
        pub conversation_id: Option<String>,
        /// Brief preview of the request content (for logging/debugging).
        #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
        pub preview: Option<String>,
    }
    
    /// Publish a responder wake notification via EMQX.
    ///
    /// This is best-effort and off the critical path — a failed publish only
    /// delays the responder's discovery of the pending request. The responder
    /// can also poll via `list_pending_for_responder()`.
    pub(crate) async fn publish_responder_wake(wake: ResponderWake, responder_principal_id: &str) {
        let args = serde_json::json!({
            "responder_principal_id": responder_principal_id,
            "request_id": wake.request_id,
            "owner_key": wake.owner_key,
            "owner_principal_id": wake.owner_principal_id,
            "conversation_id": wake.conversation_id,
            "preview": wake.preview,
        });
    
        if let Err(error) =
            op_plugins::state_plugins::emqx::dispatch_emqx_method("publish_responder_wake", &args).await
        {
            tracing::debug!(
                %error,
                "responder wake not published"
            );
        }
    }
    
    /// Build a ResponderWake for a chat turn.
    pub(crate) fn chat_turn_wake(
        turn: &crate::chat_response_turns::PendingTurn,
        message_preview: Option<&str>,
    ) -> ResponderWake {
        ResponderWake {
            request_id: turn.turn_id().to_string(),
            owner_key: crate::chat_response_state::owner_key(&turn.owner.principal_id),
            owner_principal_id: turn.owner.principal_id.clone(),
            conversation_id: Some(turn.conversation_id().to_string()),
            preview: message_preview.map(|s| truncate_preview(s, 100)),
        }
    }
    
    /// Truncate a preview string to a maximum length, adding ellipsis if needed.
    fn truncate_preview(s: &str, max_len: usize) -> String {
        if s.len() <= max_len {
            s.to_string()
        } else {
            let truncated: String = s.chars().take(max_len.saturating_sub(3)).collect();
            format!("{}...", truncated)
        }
    }
    
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        use super::*;
    
        #[test]
        fn preview_truncation() {
            assert_eq!(truncate_preview("short", 100), "short");
            let long = "a".repeat(150);
            let truncated = truncate_preview(&long, 100);
            assert!(truncated.len() <= 100);
            assert!(truncated.ends_with("..."));
        }
    
        #[test]
        fn responder_wake_serializes() {
            let wake = ResponderWake {
                request_id: "turn-123".into(),
                owner_key: "ab".repeat(32),
                owner_principal_id: "human-principal".into(),
                conversation_id: Some("conv-456".into()),

        pub fn configure_chat_response_store(
            &self,
            store: Arc<op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle>,
        ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
            if let Some(general) = self.cognitive.get() {
                store.ensure_distinct_from(&general.cozo_shuttle())?;
            }
            if let Some(episodes) = self.chatbot_episode_cozo.get() {
                store.ensure_distinct_from(episodes)?;
            }
            if let Some(gallery) = self.ui_gallery_cozo.get() {
                store.ensure_distinct_from(gallery)?;
            }
            if let Some(registry) = self.model_registry_cozo.get() {
                store.ensure_distinct_from(registry)?;
            }
            store.initialize_chat_response_store()?;
            self.chat_response_cozo
                .set(store)
                .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("chat_response Cozo owner is already configured"))
        }

        never send x-opdbus-identity-authenticated, and every control-plane chat failed
        as an unknown outcome. The door verifies the caller and the call stays on loopback.

    //! D-Bus ↔ gRPC Bidirectional Bridge
    //!
    //! Provides live synchronization between D-Bus objects and gRPC services:
    //! - D-Bus property changes → gRPC streaming updates
    //! - gRPC mutations → D-Bus method calls / property sets
    //! - D-Bus signals → gRPC server-streaming
    //! - All changes flow through the event chain for audit/compliance
    //!
    //! Architecture:
    //! ```text
    //!                     ┌─────────────────┐
    //!                     │   Event Chain   │ ← Source of truth
    //!                     │  (audit + hash) │
    //!                     └────────┬────────┘
    //!                              │
    //!               ┌──────────────┴──────────────┐
    //!               ▼                              ▼
    //!     ┌─────────────────┐            ┌─────────────────┐
    //!     │     D-Bus       │◄──────────►│      gRPC       │
    //!     │  (local IPC)    │            │  (remote RPC)   │
    //!     └─────────────────┘            └─────────────────┘
    //! ```

    //!
    //! The ChatActor is the "brain" of op-dbus-v2. It:
    //! - Receives RPC requests from various frontends (web, MCP, CLI)
    //! - Routes requests to appropriate handlers (tools, D-Bus, LLM)
    //! - Manages sessions and conversation state
    //! - **Executes tools with full tracking and accountability**
    //! - Uses ForcedToolPipeline for anti-hallucination chat

        pub max_history: usize,

        pub default_model: String,
    }

            }
        }
    }

    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum RpcRequest {
        /// List available tools
        ListTools {
            #[serde(default)]
            offset: Option<usize>,
            #[serde(default)]
            limit: Option<usize>,
        },
    
        /// Execute a tool
        ExecuteTool {
            name: String,
            arguments: Value,
            #[serde(default)]
            session_id: Option<String>,
        },
    
        /// Get tool definition
        GetTool { name: String },
    
        /// Chat with LLM
        Chat {
            message: String,
            session_id: String,
            #[serde(default)]
            model: Option<String>,
            #[serde(default)]
            container_id: Option<String>,
        },
    
        /// Get execution history
        GetHistory {
            #[serde(default)]
            limit: Option<usize>,
        },
    
        /// Get execution statistics
        GetStats,
    
        /// Health check
        Health,
    
        /// Introspect D-Bus service
        Introspect {
            service: String,
            #[serde(default)]
            bus_type: Option<String>,
        },
    
        /// Call D-Bus method
        DbusCall {
            service: String,
            path: String,
            interface: String,
            method: String,
            #[serde(default)]
            args: Value,
            #[serde(default)]
            bus_type: Option<String>,
        },
    }
    
    /// RPC Response
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct RpcResponse {
        pub success: bool,
        #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
        pub result: Option<Value>,
        #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
        pub error: Option<String>,
        #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
        pub execution_id: Option<String>,
    }
    
    impl RpcResponse {
        pub fn success(result: Value) -> Self {
            Self {
                success: true,
                result: Some(result),
                error: None,
                execution_id: None,
            }

    pub fn dispatch_chat_router_method(
        method: &str,
        json_args: &str,
        state: &ChatRouterState,
    ) -> std::result::Result<DispatchOutcome, ChatRouterError> {
        match method {
            "GetState" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(serde_json::json!({
                "state": to_json(&ObservedChatRouterState::from(state))
            }))),
            "GetModelRoutes" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
                serde_json::json!({ "model_routes": to_json(&state.catalog.model_routes) }),
            )),
            "GetTools" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
                serde_json::json!({ "tools": to_json(&state.catalog.tools) }),
            )),
            "ListProviders" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
                serde_json::json!({ "providers": to_json(&state.catalog.providers) }),
            )),
            "GetRouter" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
                serde_json::json!({ "router": to_json(&state.catalog.router) }),
            )),
            "ListUiSurfaces" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
                serde_json::json!({ "ui_surfaces": to_json(&state.catalog.ui_surfaces) }),
            )),
            "GetStructuredOutput" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
                serde_json::json!({ "structured_output": to_json(&state.catalog.structured_output) }),
            )),
            "ResolveRoute" => resolve_route(json_args, state).map(DispatchOutcome::plain),
            "ListModels" => list_models(json_args, state).map(DispatchOutcome::plain),
            "SetProvider" => set_provider_handler(json_args, state),
            "SetModel" => set_model_handler(json_args, state),
            "SetSelection" => set_selection_handler(json_args, state),
            "SetOvsRoutingModel" => set_role_model_handler(json_args, state, "ovs_routing"),
            "SetObfuscationModel" => set_role_model_handler(json_args, state, "obfuscation"),
            "SetVectorizationModel" => set_role_model_handler(json_args, state, "vectorization"),
            "SetQdrantRetrievalModel" => set_role_model_handler(json_args, state, "qdrant_retrieval"),
            "SetCozoRetrievalModel" => set_role_model_handler(json_args, state, "cozo_retrieval"),
            other => {
                let native_method = NATIVE_CONFIG_METHODS.contains(&other)
                    || generation::is_method(other)
                    || matches!(
                        other,
                        "Chat"
                            | "get_own_agent_route"
                            | "resolve_catalog_model_binding"
                            | "apply_catalog_model_binding"
                            | "config_list"
                            | "config_get"
                            | "config_set"
                            | "config_patch"
                            | "config_init"
                            | "config_migrate"
                    );
                Err(ChatRouterError::ExecutionDenied {
                    reason: if native_method {
                        format!("method requires admitted native bridge dispatch: {other}")
                    } else {
                        format!("undeclared method: {other}")
                    },
                })
            }
        }
    }
    
    fn list_models(
        json_args: &str,
        state: &ChatRouterState,
    ) -> std::result::Result<JsonValue, ChatRouterError> {
        let args = parse_args("ListModels", json_args)?;
        let provider = args
            .get("provider")
            .get("provider")
            .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let routes = state
            .catalog
            .model_routes
            .iter()
            .filter(|route| {
                provider.is_empty()
                    || route.provider.eq_ignore_ascii_case(provider)
                    || route.upstream_provider.eq_ignore_ascii_case(provider)
            })
            .cloned()
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        Ok(serde_json::json!({ "model_routes": to_json(&routes) }))
    }
    
    fn to_json<T: Serialize>(value: &T) -> JsonValue {
        serde_json::to_value(value).unwrap_or(JsonValue::Null)
    }
    
    fn parse_args(method: &str, json_args: &str) -> std::result::Result<JsonValue, ChatRouterError> {
        if json_args.trim().is_empty() {
            return Ok(serde_json::json!({}));
        }
        serde_json::from_str(json_args).map_err(|error| ChatRouterError::ExecutionDenied {
            reason: format!("{method} arguments are not valid JSON: {error}"),
        })
    }
    
    fn require_str(
        args: &JsonValue,
        field: &str,
        method: &str,
    ) -> std::result::Result<String, ChatRouterError> {
        args.get(field)
            .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
            .map(str::to_string)
            .ok_or_else(|| ChatRouterError::ExecutionDenied {
                reason: format!("{method} requires string field '{field}'"),
            })
    }
    
    fn resolve_route(
        json_args: &str,
        state: &ChatRouterState,
    ) -> std::result::Result<JsonValue, ChatRouterError> {
        let args = parse_args("ResolveRoute", json_args)?;
        let hint = require_str(&args, "hint", "ResolveRoute")?;
        state
            .catalog
            .model_routes
            .iter()
            .find(|route| route.hint == hint || route.model == hint)
            .map(|route| serde_json::json!({ "route": to_json(route) }))
            .ok_or(ChatRouterError::RouteNotDeclared { hint })

    //! Control-plane chat follows the dedicated native agent's configured model.
    //!
    //! This module observes the `control_plane` agent. It never changes the
    //! dashboard selection or accepts a request-level provider/model override.
    
    use std::sync::Arc;
    
    use anyhow::{Context, ensure};
    use op_plugins::state_plugins::chat_router::{ChatInput, ChatOutput};
    use serde::Serialize;
    
    use crate::chat_mode_routing::CONTROL_PLANE_AGENT;
    use crate::chat_router_generation::NativeGenerationAdmission;
    use crate::chat_router_runtime::{RuntimeSelection, ChatRouterRuntimeClient};
    
    #[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
    struct RouteDecision<'a> {
        native_alias: &'a str,
        provider: &'a str,
        model: &'a str,
        source: &'a str,
    }
    
    /// Pin the observed native selection into the request. Caller-supplied
    /// provider/model fields are not control-plane configuration authority.
    fn apply_native_selection(
        input: &mut ChatInput,
        selection: &RuntimeSelection,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        ensure!(
            !selection.provider.trim().is_empty() && !selection.model.trim().is_empty(),
            "control-plane native agent has no configured provider/model"
        );
        input.provider.clone_from(&selection.provider);
        input.model.clone_from(&selection.model);
        Ok(())
    }
    
    /// Execute under the caller's existing native admission guard. Provider-only
    /// callers use stateless generation; chat callers use the native A2A agent.
    pub(crate) async fn complete(
        input: ChatInput,
        before_prompt: Arc<dyn NativeGenerationAdmission>,
        provider_only: bool,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<ChatOutput> {
        let client = ChatRouterRuntimeClient::for_agent_alias(CONTROL_PLANE_AGENT)
            .with_sealed_identity(before_prompt.sealed_identity());
        complete_with_client(input, before_prompt, provider_only, client).await
    }
    
    async fn complete_with_client(
        mut input: ChatInput,
        before_prompt: Arc<dyn NativeGenerationAdmission>,
        provider_only: bool,
        client: ChatRouterRuntimeClient,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<ChatOutput> {
        before_prompt
            .check()
            .await
            .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("control-plane routing admission failed: {error}"))?;
        let selection = client
            .current_selection()
            .await
            .context("control-plane native agent selection is unavailable")?;
        apply_native_selection(&mut input, &selection)?;
        before_prompt
            .check()
            .await
            .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("control-plane execution admission failed: {error}"))?;
        let mut output = if provider_only {
            client.complete_under_guard(input, before_prompt).await?
        } else {
            client.chat_under_guard(input).await?
        };
        ensure!(
            output.provider == selection.provider && output.model == selection.model,
            "control-plane native execution did not retain its observed provider/model"
        );
        if !output.usage.is_object() {
            output.usage = serde_json::json!({});
        }
        output.usage["routing"] = serde_json::to_value(RouteDecision {
            native_alias: CONTROL_PLANE_AGENT,
            provider: &output.provider,
            model: &output.model,
            source: "native_agent",
        })?;
        Ok(output)
    }

        /// Caller retains the admitted router operation guard through this native request.
        pub(crate) async fn chat_under_guard(&self, input: ChatInput) -> anyhow::Result<ChatOutput> {
            let prompt = conversation_prompt(&input)?;
            let body = json!({
                "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                "id": uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
                "method": "message/send",
                "params": {"message": {"role": "user", "parts": [{"kind": "text", "text": prompt}]}}
            });
            anyhow::ensure!(
                serde_json::to_vec(&body)?.len() <= MAX_CHAT_REQUEST_BYTES,
                "native chat request exceeds {MAX_CHAT_REQUEST_BYTES} bytes"
            );
            self.health().await?;
            let observed = self.current_provider().await?;
            if !matches_provider_selector(&input.provider, &observed) {
                return Err(anyhow!(
                    "requested provider '{}' differs from chat_router's selected provider '{}'",
                    input.provider,
                    observed.reference
                ));
            }
            if !input.model.trim().is_empty()
                && !input.model.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&observed.selected_model)
            {
                return Err(anyhow!(
                    "requested model '{}' differs from chat_router's selected model '{}'",
                    input.model,
                    observed.selected_model
                ));
            }
    
            let response: Value = self
                .send_json(
                    self.http()?
                        .post(format!("{}/a2a/{}", self.endpoint, self.agent_alias))
                        .json(&body),
                    "chat",
                    CHAT_TIMEOUT,
                    MAX_CHAT_RESPONSE_BYTES,
                )
                .await?;
            if let Some(error) = response.get("error") {
                let message = error
                    .get("message")
                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
                    .unwrap_or("unknown chat_router A2A error");
                return Err(anyhow!(
                    "chat_router chat failed: {}",
                    truncate_error(message)
                ));
            }
            let content = extract_chat_text(&response)?;
            Ok(ChatOutput {
                content,
                provider: observed.family,
                model: observed.selected_model,
                finish_reason: String::new(),
                usage: Value::Null,
            })
        }
    }
    
    fn valid_config_segment(value: &str) -> bool {
        !value.is_empty()
            && value.len() <= MAX_CONFIG_PATH_BYTES
            && value
                .bytes()
                .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'_' | b'-'))
    }
    
    fn validate_config_value(value: &Value) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        let encoded = serde_json::to_vec(value).context("serialize config value for bounds check")?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            encoded.len() <= MAX_CONFIG_VALUE_BYTES,
            "config value exceeds {MAX_CONFIG_VALUE_BYTES} bytes"
        );
        Ok(())
    }

        async fn get_state(
            &self,
            request: Request<GetStateRequest>,
        ) -> Result<Response<GetStateResponse>, Status> {
            let verified_identity =
                crate::event_chain_access::verified_identity(&self.mutation_engine, &request).await?;
            if let Some(selection) = crate::chatbot_episode_stream::EpisodeSelection::from_get_state(
                &request.get_ref().plugin_id,
                &request.get_ref().object_path,
            )
            .map_err(|_| Status::invalid_argument("invalid private chatbot episode selection"))?
            {
                return crate::chatbot_episode_stream::get_state(
                    self.mutation_engine.clone(),
                    request,
                    verified_identity,
                    selection,
                )
                .await
                .map(Response::new);
            }
            if let Some(selection) =
                crate::generation_jobs_selection::GenerationSelection::from_get_state(
                    &request.get_ref().plugin_id,
                    &request.get_ref().object_path,
                )
                .map_err(|_| Status::invalid_argument("invalid private generation selection"))?
            {
                return crate::generation_jobs_stream::get_state(
                    self.mutation_engine.clone(),
                    request,
                    verified_identity,
                    selection,
                )
                .await
                .map(Response::new);
            }
            let private_selection =
                crate::ui_workspace_stream_selection::WorkspaceSelection::from_get_state(
                    &request.get_ref().plugin_id,
                    &request.get_ref().object_path,
                )
                .map_err(|_| Status::invalid_argument("invalid private workspace selection"))?;
            if let Some(selection) = private_selection {
                return crate::ui_workspace_stream::get_state(
                    self.mutation_engine.clone(),
                    request,
                    verified_identity,
                    selection,
                )
                .await
                .map(Response::new);
            }
            let req = request.into_inner();
            let snapshot =
                crate::state_stream::read_public_state_snapshot(std::slice::from_ref(&req.plugin_id))
                    .await
                    .map_err(public_state_status)?;
            let plugin = snapshot
                .plugins
                .get(&req.plugin_id)
                .ok_or_else(|| Status::not_found("plugin is absent from the sealed catalog"))?;
            let root_state = plugin
                .state
                .as_ref()
                .ok_or_else(|| Status::not_found("plugin has no committed public SHM state"))?;
            let requested_path = if req.object_path.is_empty() {
                crate::state_stream::plugin_object_path(&req.plugin_id)
            } else {
                req.object_path
            };
            crate::state_stream::validate_public_path_patterns(std::slice::from_ref(&requested_path))
                .map_err(|error| Status::invalid_argument(error.to_string()))?;
            let root_path = crate::state_stream::plugin_object_path(&req.plugin_id);
            if requested_path != root_path && !requested_path.starts_with(&(root_path.clone() + "/")) {
                return Err(Status::invalid_argument(
                    "GetState object path is outside the public plugin tree",
                ));
            }
            let state =
                crate::state_stream::state_at_object_path(&req.plugin_id, root_state, &requested_path)
